items.title_en: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
items.title_zh: 英伟达同意以130亿美元收购 Hugging Face
items.summary_en: NVIDIA plans to buy Hugging Face for $13 billion, positioning its software ecosystem to ride alongside its hardware stack. The acquisition would deepen integration of models, datasets, and tools across the NVIDIA platform, potentially accelerating AI deployment and the competitive dynamics of AI infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达以130亿美元收购 Hugging Face，意在把开源模型生态融入自家硬件与软件工具链。交易可能加速 AI 部署并改变 AI 基础设施的竞争格局，同时影响开源社区的格局。

items.title_en: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs
items.title_zh: 欧洲如何扼杀制造者和微型创业者
items.summary_en: Europe is tightening rules that raise compliance costs for small-scale makers and micro-entrepreneurs. The higher friction could slow hardware startups and push more innovation to friendlier regions, reshaping local maker ecosystems. This trend matters for hardware, IoT, and regional tech communities.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲正在收紧法规，提升小规模制造者和微型创业者的合规成本。更高的摩擦可能放缓硬件创业，并将更多创新挪向更友好的地区，重塑本地创客生态。此趋势关系到硬件、物联网以及区域科技社群。

items.title_en: Dolly Parton has died
items.title_zh: 多莉·帕顿去世
items.summary_en: Tributes pour in as Dolly Parton is reported to have died, marking the loss of a legendary singer, songwriter, and philanthropist. Her influence across country music and pop culture endures through hits, artistry, and charitable work.
items.summary_zh: 传闻称多莉·帕顿去世，这位传奇歌手、词曲创作者及慈善家的离世引发广泛悼念。她在乡村音乐和流行文化中的影响力通过经典作品、艺术成就与慈善事业继续留存。

items.title_en: Everything I own, owned
items.title_zh: 我所拥有的一切，终究被拥有
items.summary_en: Explores what it means to own things in a world where ownership can be distributed and intangible.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在一个所有权可以分散且无形的世界里，拥有到底意味着什么。

items.title_en: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra
items.title_zh: 苹果推出 M6 与 M5 Ultra 引领性能与 AI 算力大跃升
items.summary_en: Apple claims M6 and M5 Ultra deliver a substantial jump in CPU/GPU performance and on‑device AI compute, enabling heavier workloads like real‑time inference and larger models at the edge. The chips are expected to bring higher memory bandwidth and improved neural accelerators, reinforcing Apple’s pro workflow ambitions across its lineup. For developers and creators, this sets a new baseline for on‑device AI capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 苹果称 M6 与 M5 Ultra 将在 CPU/GPU 性能与边缘 AI 算力方面实现显著跃升，使实时推理和更大模型在本地可运行。新芯片预计带来更高的内存带宽与改进的神经处理单元，强化其在 Pro 级工作流中的布局。对于开发者与创作者来说，标志着本地 AI 能力的新基线。

items.title_en: GLM-5.3-Flash
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary_en: A new release in the GLM-5.3 family focusing on cost-efficient inference, likely leveraging quantization and optimization tricks to run capable models on cheaper hardware. This broadens practical deployment of large language models on commodity devices and smaller clusters. The trend continues: vendors pushing cheaper, accessible LLMs without sacrificing too much accuracy.
items.summary_zh: GLM-5.3-Flash 发布，强调在低成本硬件上的高效推理，可能通过量化与优化实现更便宜设备上的可用模型。此举扩展了大模型在普通硬件/小型集群上的落地场景，体现了厂商在降低部署成本上的持续努力。

items.title_en: AWS Acquires DuckLabs
items.title_zh: AWS 收购 DuckLabs
items.summary_en: Amazon Web Services has acquired DuckLabs to bolster its data tooling and AI capabilities. The acquisition signals AWS's push to integrate DuckLabs' technology into its cloud platform, potentially expanding its offerings for data-driven workloads.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊网络服务宣布收购 DuckLabs，以增强其数据工具和人工智能能力。这笔交易可能将把 DuckLabs 的技术融入 AWS 的云平台，拓展数据驱动工作负载的能力。

items.title_en: Nitter and XCancel receive cease and desist notices
items.title_zh: Nitter 与 XCancel 收到停止令通知
items.summary_en: Independent Twitter frontends like Nitter and XCancel have received cease-and-desist notices. The action underscores ongoing legal pressure on third-party clients that access a platform's content and raises questions about privacy-focused, lightweight access versus platform control.
items.summary_zh: 独立的 Twitter 前端 Nitter 与 XCancel 收到停止令，凸显第三方前端在访问平台内容时面临的法律压力。此举引发对隐私导向、轻量级访问与平台控制之间平衡的讨论。

items.title_en: CEO fired developers to make room for AI. Developers create open source AI CEO
items.title_zh: CEO 为了给 AI 腾出空间而解雇开发者，开发者推出开源 AI CEO
items.summary_en: A CEO allegedly fired developers to make room for AI, prompting debates about AI governance and corporate strategy; in response, a team of developers created an open-source AI CEO project to explore decentralized AI leadership.
items.summary_zh: 报道称某CEO为让AI腾出空间而解雇开发者，引发关于 AI 治理与企业策略的讨论。开发者们进而推出了开源 AI CEO 项目（OpenExecutive），以探索去中心化的 AI 领导力。

items.title_en: GUIs should be fully keyboard-driven
items.title_zh: GUI 应实现全键盘可用性
items.summary_en: Advocates argue that GUIs should be navigable entirely via keyboard to boost accessibility and speed.
items.summary_zh: 主张将 GUI 完全通过键盘操作来实现可访问性与效率提升。文中提出若干设计模式与工具，帮助减少对鼠标的依赖，使应用对无障碍用户和高效工作流用户更友好。

items.title_en: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.title_zh: 小米新 CPU：单核媲美苹果核心，多核性能显著提升
items.summary_en: A new Xiaomi CPU delivers single-thread performance that rivals Apple cores, while delivering notably higher throughput on multi-threaded workloads. The design emphasis appears to optimize threading efficiency and instruction-level parallelism, challenging assumptions about relative performance across mobile SoCs. The result could shift expectations for mid-range and flagship Android devices.
items.summary_zh: 新一代小米处理器在单线程性能上接近苹果核心，而在多线程工作负载上则显著更快。此设计似乎强调对线程效率和指令级并行性的优化，挑战了移动SoC之间性能的普遍认知。对于中高端安卓设备的期望可能因此发生变化。

items.title_en: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
items.title_zh: 通过优化 1.1.1.1 的 DNS 缓存节省 100 TB 内存
items.summary_en: Cloudflare details how reworking DNS cache structures and eviction policies shaved hundreds of terabytes of memory from a global resolver fleet. The change improves throughput and latency while reducing operational costs.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 讲解了通过重构 DNS 缓存结构和淘汰策略，在全球解析器网络中节省了数百 TB 内存。此举提升了吞吐和延迟表现，同时降低运维成本。

items.title_en: Creepy Crawlies
items.title_zh: 令人毛骨悚然的爬虫
items.summary_en: Creepy Crawlies
items.summary_zh: 简要地反思软件与系统中那些诡异、常被忽视的细节。

items.title_en: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.title_zh: MS Paint 与 Photos 对本地生成输出隐藏水印
items.summary_en: Researchers found that MS Paint and Photos embed invisible watermarks in images, even for outputs created locally, using GUIDs. The watermarking enables provenance tracking but raises privacy and control concerns for users who expect watermark-free content.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现，MS Paint 与 Photos 在本地生成的图片中嵌入不可见水印，使用 GUID 进行标记。水印提供可溯源性，但引发隐私与对内容控制的担忧。

items.title_en: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
items.title_zh: Cursor 被 SpaceX 收购后的未来走向
items.summary_en: Our decision on Cursor after SpaceX's acquisition clarifies the product's future and commitments to users. The plan outlines how Cursor will be supported and positioned within SpaceX's ecosystem, with implications for developers and enterprise deployments.
items.summary_zh: Cursor 在被 SpaceX 收购后未来走向的决定，明确了对用户的承诺与支持方向。文档说明 Cursor 的未来定位、在 SpaceX 生态中的角色，以及对开发者和企业部署的影响。

items.title_en: New Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
items.title_zh: 苹果推出新款 Mac Studio，搭载 M5 Max 与 M5 Ultra
items.summary_en: Apple expands the Mac Studio lineup with the M5 Max and M5 Ultra, pairing the compact desktop chassis with redesigned high-end chips. The new CPUs and GPUs aim to boost workstation-class performance for creators and developers, especially in AI-enabled workloads and large-scale builds. This reinforces Apple's strategy of delivering formidable pro compute in a small form factor.
items.summary_zh: 苹果在 Mac Studio 系列中引入 M5 Max 和 M5 Ultra，继续以紧凑机箱实现高端算力。新芯片对创作者与开发者的 AI 相关工作负载以及大型编译任务提供更强性能，彰显苹果在小型工作站领域提升 Pro 级算力的策略。

items.title_en: Htmx 4.0
items.title_zh: Htmx 4.0 发布
items.summary_en: Htmx 4.0 launches with a refreshed API surface and broader server-driven UI capabilities, further simplifying dynamic pages without heavy JavaScript frameworks. The release tightens bindings around hx- attributes and adds improvements for streaming and partial updates, keeping htmx attractive for developers seeking low-friction interactivity.
items.summary_zh: Htmx 4.0 发布，API 面貌焕新，扩展了服务器驱动的 UI 能力，进一步简化在不依赖大规模 JS 框架的情况下实现动态页面的开发。新版本加强了对 hx- 属性的集成，并在流式更新与局部页面更新方面带来改进，继续巩固了它在追求低摩擦交互的开发者中的定位。

items.title_en: GLM-5.3 is now open-weight
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3 已开源权重
items.summary_en: An open-weight release lets researchers run the model locally and inspect behavior; it aids reproducibility and benchmarking. The move signals growing openness in large-language-model ecosystems and invites community experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 公开权重意味着研究者可以本地运行模型、研究推理过程，提升复现实验和基准对比的可信度。此举体现了大语言模型生态的开放化趋势，并鼓励社区参与和改进。

items.title_en: U.S. State Department pauses immigrant visa applications
items.title_zh: 美国国务院暂停移民签证申请
items.summary_en: The U.S. State Department paused immigrant visa applications amid processing backlogs and security concerns, affecting applicants and consular operations. The halt is expected to have widespread impact on families awaiting immigration.
items.summary_zh: 美国国务院因处理积压与安全问题暂停移民签证申请，影响申请人及领事馆运作。此举预计会对等待移民的家庭造成广泛影响。

items.title_en: Anthropic's best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的最佳 AI 模型在吸引用户方面遇冷，便宜工具更受欢迎
items.summary_en: Reports that Anthropic's top AI model is failing to attract users as cheaper competitors gain traction, raising questions about pricing, UX, and use-case fit. The piece suggests that access cost and ease of integration matter as much as raw capability for adoption.
items.summary_zh: 报道显示Anthropic 的顶尖 AI 模型在市场上难以吸引用户，便宜的竞争对手更具吸引力。这提出定价、用户体验和用例匹配等因素与能力同等重要的结论。

items.title_en: Small Models Have Arrived
items.title_zh: 小型模型已到来
items.summary_en: Smaller AI models are reaching practical viability, enabling on-device and cost-effective deployments. The piece surveys advances in distillation, quantization, and architecture design that let smaller models perform surprisingly well.
items.summary_zh: 更小的AI模型正在具备实际应用能力，能够在本地设备上部署并降低成本。文章梳理了蒸馏、量化和架构设计方面的进展，使小模型的性能出人意料地强。

items.title_en: Microduck
items.title_zh: Microduck
items.summary_en: Microduck is a new, compact robotics platform introduced by Pollen Robotics.
items.summary_zh: Microduck 是 Pollen Robotics 推出的一款新型、紧凑型的机器人平台。

items.title_en: Andreessen Horowitz is investing billions into a bleak future
items.title_zh: A16z在黯淡未来中投出数十亿美元
items.summary_en: Andreessen Horowitz is deploying billions into bets on a purportedly bleak future, backing AI, crypto, and frontier tech across its portfolio. The piece analyzes why a16z-funded bets persist despite macro headwinds, and what it implies for startups, competition, and policy shaping.
items.summary_zh: A16z正向其投资组合投放数十亿美元，覆盖AI、加密等前沿领域，押注一个被描绘为艰难的未来。文章分析在宏观环境不确定的情况下为何仍持续进行此类长期赌注，以及这对初创公司、竞争格局与政策走向意味着什么。

items.title_en: Tim Curry has died
items.title_zh: 蒂姆·库里去世
items.summary_en: Tim Curry, the versatile actor known for roles in The Rocky Horror Picture Show and IT, has died. Tributes highlight his flamboyant stage presence and iconic performances across film and television.
items.summary_zh: 知名演员蒂姆·库里去世，因其在舞台与银幕上塑造的标志性角色而广受赞誉。人们怀念他在《摇滚惊魂夜》等作品中的多才多艺与大胆表演。

items.title_en: Get your Windows license refund
items.title_zh: 申请 Windows 许可证退款
items.summary_en: Many software-licensing schemes carry refund options, and this guide outlines practical steps to reclaim the cost of a Windows license. It covers common eligibility paths, expected timelines, and what documentation you’ll need to speed things up.
items.summary_zh: 一些 Windows 许可证购买后可以申请退款。本文提供可行的退款途径、所需材料与大致时间线，并强调在申诉时要准备好购买凭证与相关政策条款。

items.title_en: Oceans hit highest temperature on record
items.title_zh: 海洋温度达到历史新高
items.summary_en: Oceans have reached record warm temperatures, underscoring the persistent impact of climate change. The heat uptake reshapes marine ecosystems and intensifies weather extremes, with broad implications for policy, fisheries, and carbon cycling.
items.summary_zh: 海洋温度达到历史最高水平，凸显气候变化的持续影响。海水升温改变海洋生态、加剧极端天气，并对政策、渔业和碳循环产生广泛影响。

items.title_en: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
items.title_zh: 加州通过 Linux 豁免年龄验证法
items.summary_en: California lawmakers unanimously exempt Linux and GPL-licensed software from the state's age-verification requirement, preserving open-source distribution channels. The move clarifies that common open-source licenses shield software from age checks while still applying to other content.
items.summary_zh: 加州立法者一致通过针对 Linux 与 GPL 等开源软件的年龄验证豁免，确保开源软件的分发不受额外年龄要求限制。这一举措澄清了在某些内容需要年龄验证时，开源许可的软件不受这些限制。

items.title_en: I spent $266 and four AI models to own my tablet. GLM-5.3 finished it in a day
items.title_zh: 我花266美元和四个AI模型搞定我的平板，GLM-5.3一天就完成了
items.summary_en: An enthusiast spent 266 dollars across four AI models to tackle a tablet task, with GLM-5.3 emerging as the fastest solution, finishing the job in a day. The experiment underscores how open-weight models can rapidly displace more expensive, closed options for hands-on device tinkering.
items.summary_zh: 一位爱好者用266美元、并借助四个AI模型完成对平板的某项挑战，结果由GLM-5.3在一天内解决。此举凸显开源权重模型在成本和速度上的竞争力，适合个人或小团队进行硬件与软件的快速试验。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：全新架构，向极致成本效率迈进
items.summary_en: Qwen unveils 3.8-Flash-Next with a new architecture designed to slash total cost of ownership. Early signals point to modular design and hardware-aware optimizations that improve throughput per dollar. If adopted widely, it could shift how enterprises balance model capability with operating expense.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 推出 3.8-Flash-Next，采用新架构以显著降低总体拥有成本。初步迹象显示将采用模块化设计和面向硬件的优化提高性价比。如果被广泛采用，可能改变企业在模型能力与运维成本之间的取舍。

items.title_en: U.S. sanctions against the A/I Collective
items.title_zh: 美国对 a/I Collective 的制裁
items.summary_en: The U.S. has imposed sanctions on the a/I Collective, expanding its toolkit against cyber-enabled operations.
items.summary_zh: 美国对 a/I Collective 实施制裁，扩大了对网络相关行动的打击范围。

items.title_en: “It works better in the app”
items.title_zh: “在应用中效果更佳”
items.summary_en: Examines why some users perceive apps as delivering a superior experience than web equivalents. It discusses factors like offline support, performance, and deeper platform integration that apps can leverage.
items.summary_zh: 探讨为何有些用户认为桌面/移动应用在体验上优于网页版。讨论离线、速度与对平台深度集成等因素如何让应用提供更高质量的体验。

items.title_en: 507 Mechanical Movements
items.title_zh: 507 种机械运动
items.summary_en: A modern, interactive catalog of mechanical linkages illustrating 507 different movements. It serves as a visually engaging reference for designers and engineers exploring how different parts convert motion.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个现代化、交互式的机械连杆目录，展示了507种不同的运动方式。为设计师和工程师提供直观的可视参考，帮助理解各部件如何转换运动。

items.title_en: Tailcat – Like netcat, but over Tailscale’s data plane
items.title_zh: Tailcat：在 Tailscale 数据平面上的 netcat 替代品
items.summary_en: Tailcat provides a netcat-style data channel that rides on Tailscale's data plane, allowing direct, authenticated connections between devices regardless of NATs. It offers a lightweight way to test services, tunnel traffic, and diagnose network issues without exposing endpoints publicly.
items.summary_zh: Tailcat 在 Tailscale 的数据平面上实现类似 netcat 的数据通道，能够在 NAT 穿透的设备之间建立经过认证的直接连接。它为测试、隧道传输和网络排错提供了一个轻量的替代方案，无需暴露公网端点。

items.title_en: Show HN: The load-bearing vocabulary of Claude
items.title_zh: Claude 的承载词汇
items.summary_en: An analysis of Claude's vocabulary that matters for reliable performance, exploring which words most influence model behavior.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Claude 模型中对稳定表现最关键的词汇，以及哪些词汇对模型行为影响最大。

items.title_en: My Friend Aaron
items.title_zh: 我的朋友 Aaron
items.summary_en: A personal essay about the author's friend Aaron.
items.summary_zh: 作者关于朋友Aaron的一篇个人随笔。

items.title_en: iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com
items.title_zh: iCloud+ Hide My Email 地址将保留在 icloud.com 上
items.summary_en: Apple says Hide My Email aliases will stay on iCloud.com, ensuring consistent privacy options across devices. The move affects how users manage aliases, inbox organization, and service interoperability within Apple’s ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 苹果表示 Hide My Email 的邮箱别名将继续保留在 iCloud.com 上，确保跨设备的隐私选项一致。此举影响用户如何管理别名、收件箱组织以及在苹果生态系统内的服务互操作性。

items.title_en: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.title_zh: 把整座旧金山变成一个电子游戏
items.summary_en: San Francisco is reimagined as a video game in a data-driven visualization, offering interactive exploration of the city as digital terrain. The project illustrates how urban data and maps can fuel novel experiences and potentially inform planning and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 一个数据驱动的可视化把旧金山想象成一个电子游戏，提供对城市的互动式探索。该项目展示了城市数据与地图如何孕育新型体验，并可能为城市规划与无障碍设计提供新视角。

items.title_en: Judge rules Trump administration’s blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal
items.title_zh: 法官裁定特朗普政府对 Anthropic 的黑名单措施违法
items.summary_en: A court found that the Trump administration's blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal, citing improper authority or process. The ruling reinforces legal checks on government actions in tech and procurement, and may influence future regulatory tactics in the AI ecosystem. The decision signals enforceable limits on executive power in tech policy.
items.summary_zh: 法院裁定特朗普政府试图将 Anthropic 列入黑名单的行为违法，指出权力与程序受限。判决强调政府在科技采购中的权力边界与法治约束，可能影响未来对 AI 公司的监管手段，对政府打击科技公司的策略形成制衡。

items.title_en: Inception-style curved map for turn-by-turn directions
items.title_zh: Inception 风格的曲线地图用于逐向导航
items.summary_en: Orbify demonstrates a curved, inception-inspired map for turn-by-turn directions, offering aesthetically curved paths to improve readability and context on mobile devices.
items.summary_zh: Inception 风格的曲线地图原型用于逐向导航，沿曲面呈现路线，以提升在移动设备上的可读性与上下文感。

items.title_en: I were 17, I'd learn how to build LLMs from scratch
items.title_zh: 如果我17岁，我会从零开始学习如何构建大语言模型
items.summary_en: Learning the fundamentals now pays off later. Hands-on practice building LLMs from scratch builds intuition about architectures, data, and training dynamics. The takeaway is to focus on practical experimentation rather than relying solely on prebuilt APIs.
items.summary_zh: 如果年轻时就动手学习并从零开始构建LLMs，能更好掌握原理和局限。文章强调要认真理解架构、数据与训练过程，而不仅仅依赖现成的API。如此能培养工程直觉与创新能力。

items.title_en: How I find problems to solve as a staff engineer
items.title_zh: 我在担任资深工程师时如何发现待解决的问题
items.summary_en: Learn a practical framework for identifying high-leverage problems as a staff engineer by combining system signals, user pain points, and business impact. The piece emphasizes partnering with product and ops, triaging by impact and effort, and turning findings into scoped initiatives with measurable outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍在担任资深工程师时如何通过系统信号、用户痛点和业务影响来发现高杠杆的问题，提供实用框架。强调与产品和运维协作、按影响与投入进行优先级排序，并将发现转化为有明确可衡量目标的计划。

items.title_en: What Is a Harness?
items.title_zh: What Is a Harness？
items.summary_en: A harness is a framework for coordinating and running software tasks, experiments, or deployments.
items.summary_zh: Harness 是用于协调和运行软件任务、实验或部署的框架。

items.title_en: Twitter Viewer – View Twitter Without Account
items.title_zh: Twitter Viewer：无需账户查看 Twitter
items.summary_en: Twitter Viewer lets you read public tweets without signing in, offering a privacy-friendly way to access content. It can be handy for researchers, journalists, and developers, but may raise policy and data-access questions as platforms tighten APIs. It exemplifies how third-party tooling can bypass friction while highlighting the limits of platform control.
items.summary_zh: Twitter Viewer 允许在不登录的情况下浏览公开推文，为访问信息提供了更隐私友好的方式。对研究人员、记者和开发者颇有帮助，但随着平台收紧 API，相关的政策与数据访问问题亦随之浮现。此工具体现了第三方工具在降低门槛与平台控制能力之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance
items.title_zh: AI 依赖将让编码技能崩塌
items.summary_en: AI-powered coding tools risk eroding developers' fundamental expertise if people rely on them for all reasoning. The piece argues for training models, better education, and tooling that preserve understanding of underlying concepts rather than turning programmers into button-pushers.
items.summary_zh: 如果人们把所有推理都交给 AI 编码工具，开发者的基础专业能力可能会退化。文章主张通过改进教育、培养培训模式，以及提供能保留对根本概念理解的工具，而非让程序员成为“点按按钮者”。

items.title_en: OpenAI Jalapeño: Better than Nvidia Blackwell
items.title_zh: OpenAI Jalapeño：胜过 Nvidia Blackwell
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Jalapeño accelerator is discussed as potentially outperforming Nvidia's Blackwell in key workloads, signaling rapid shifts in the AI hardware landscape. The piece weighs architecture choices, efficiency, and the race to deliver cheaper, faster AI compute.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 OpenAI 的 Jalapeño 加速器在关键工作负载上可能优于 Nvidia 的 Blackwell，显示 AI 硬件领域竞争加速。内容评估了架构、效率和更廉价高效的 AI 计算的竞争格局。

items.title_en: Trade (and Tariffs)
items.title_zh: 贸易（与关税）
items.summary_en: A humorous XKCD strip exploring how tariffs affect trade dynamics and consumer costs, with a simple, accessible take on economic policy.
items.summary_zh: 这幅 XKCD 漫画以幽默方式揭示关税如何影响贸易与消费者成本的基本逻辑。

items.title_en: Mechanical Turk shutting down September 30
items.title_zh: Amazon Mechanical Turk 将于9月30日停止运营
items.summary_en: Amazon Mechanical Turk will shut down on Sept 30, ending a long-running crowdwork and data-labeling platform for ML. The move affects researchers and companies relying on microtasks, pushing them to alternatives or in-house labeling workflows.
items.summary_zh: Amazon Mechanical Turk 将于9月30日停止运营。这一决策结束了长期用于众包任务和机器学习数据标注的平台，相关方需转向其他平台或自行开展标注工作。

items.title_en: Meta reaches $17B settlement over social media harms to children
items.title_zh: Meta就儿童在社交媒体上的伤害达成170亿美元和解
items.summary_en: Meta agrees to a $17 billion settlement with U.S. states over alleged harms to children from its social platforms. The deal includes funding for safety improvements, independent oversight, and a framework to curb risky design patterns affecting young users, underscoring regulatory pressure on big tech.
items.summary_zh: Meta 与多州就其社交平台对儿童造成的有害影响达成170亿美元和解。和解包括加强安全措施、独立监督，以及限制有害设计模式的合规要求，体现了监管对大型科技公司的持续压力。

items.title_en: Executable Is a SQLite Database
items.title_zh: 可执行文件就是一个 SQLite 数据库
items.summary_en: Treating an executable as a SQLite database reframes how we analyze and store binary code, enabling structured querying and tooling. The perspective suggests new ways to inspect, modify, or reason about binaries without abandoning traditional formats.
items.summary_zh: 把可执行程序当作 SQLite 数据库来看待，能以结构化的方式对二进制代码进行分析、查询和工具化操作。这一视角可能带来新的二进制分析方法，促进对现有格式的补充性思考。

items.title_en: New Mac mini, featuring M6 and M5 Pro
items.title_zh: 苹果发布新款Mac mini，搭载M6与M5 Pro
items.summary_en: The Mac mini receives a performance boost with the M6 and M5 Pro, extending strong compute capabilities in an ultra-compact form factor. The update targets developers, media workflows, and light server tasks that benefit from efficient, high‑density compute. It broadens Apple's entry-level pro workstation options without increasing the footprint.
items.summary_zh: Mac mini 通过 M6 与 M5 Pro 获得性能提升，在极小的机身中扩展了计算能力。更新面向开发者、媒体工作流以及需要高效率密度计算的轻量服务器场景，提供更强的入门级 pro 工作站选择，同时保持小巧体积。

items.title_en: Tether: iMessage, SMS, etc. on Linux
items.title_zh: Tether：在 Linux 上实现 iMessage、SMS 等通信
items.summary_en: A project called Tether lets Linux users access iMessage and SMS by bridging to an iPhone, bringing Apple’s messaging to Linux desktop. It highlights the friction-filled gap between ecosystems and how open-source tooling can bridge messaging across platforms.
items.summary_zh: 一个名为 Tether 的项目让 Linux 用户通过与 iPhone 桥接来使用 iMessage、SMS 等消息，将 Apple 的消息生态带到 Linux 桌面。它凸显了不同生态系统之间的割裂，以及开源工具如何构建跨平台的消息桥接。

items.title_en: Luanti removed from Google Play due to baseless AI copyright notice
items.title_zh: Luanti 因无根据的 AI 版权通知被 Google Play 下架
items.summary_en: Luanti has been removed from Google Play following a DMCA notice about AI-generated copyright claims; the developers contend the takedown is baseless and argue for due process in app stores' handling of AI content.
items.summary_zh: Luanti 因关于 AI 版权的 DMCA 通知被 Google Play 下架，开发者称该下架毫无根据并呼吁正当程序。

items.title_en: Tell HN: PayPal blocks GrapheneOS
items.title_zh: HN 贴：PayPal 阻止 GrapheneOS
items.summary_en: PayPal blocks GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused Android fork, affecting users and highlighting tensions between large payment platforms and alternative mobile ecosystems. This underscores concerns about platform interoperability, device compatibility, and vendor gatekeeping.
items.summary_zh: 据称 PayPal 阻止 GrapheneOS 用户使用其服务，凸显大型支付平台与隐私导向的操作系统之间的紧张关系。事件引发对跨平台兼容性、设备认证以及厂商封禁策略的讨论。

items.title_en: Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"
items.title_zh: Debian 决定允许生成式 AI 的负责任使用
items.summary_en: Debian voted to permit responsible use of generative AI in its workflows, with guardrails to address licensing and safety. The decision signals how a major, community-driven distro balances AI-assisted tooling with trust and reproducibility in open source.
items.summary_zh: Debian 投票同意在其工作流程中允许生成式 AI 的负责任使用，并设立守则以应对安全与许可等问题。这体现出开源社区在 AI 辅助开发中寻求平衡，既利用新工具也维护可重复性与信任基础。

items.title_en: RAG Is Simpler Than You Think
items.title_zh: RAG 比你想象的更简单
items.summary_en: A concise explainer demystifies retrieval-augmented generation, outlining core components and practical patterns for building RAG systems.
items.summary_zh: 简要解析让 Retrieval-Augmented Generation(检索增强生成)不再神秘，梳理核心组件与落地实践模式。

items.title_en: An ongoing 3D-printer AGPL violation
items.title_zh: 3D 打印机领域持续的 AGPL 许可证违规
items.summary_en: The article documents an ongoing AGPL license violation in a 3D printer ecosystem, highlighting licensing compliance challenges for hardware vendors. It discusses potential enforcement paths and the impact on open-source developers and users.
items.summary_zh: 文中记录了一个持续的 AGPL 许可证违规案例，涉及 3D 打印机生态系统，凸显硬件厂商在开源许可方面的合规挑战。文中分析了可能的执法路径以及对开源开发者和用户的影响。

items.title_en: FDA authorizes first wearable device that monitors ketone and blood sugar levels
items.title_zh: FDA 批准首款同时监测酮体与血糖的可穿戴设备
items.summary_en: The FDA has authorized the first wearable that continuously monitors both ketone and blood glucose levels. This milestone signals a move toward integrated metabolic monitoring on consumer devices, enabling richer data for diabetes and metabolic health management. With real-time keto- and glucose-trend data, clinicians and patients may improve treatment decisions, but it also raises questions about data privacy, interoperability, and how to interpret combined metrics.
items.summary_zh: FDA 批准首款能持续监测酮体和血糖水平的可穿戴设备。该里程碑推动了将代谢监测整合到消费级设备的趋势，为糖尿病与代谢健康管理提供更丰富的数据，实时的趋势信息有望帮助医生和患者做出更精准的治疗决策，同时也引发数据隐私、互操作性以及解读综合指标等问题。

items.title_en: Nebula Sans
items.title_zh: Nebula Sans 字体
items.summary_en: Nebula Sans is a new font family designed for clean UI typography and legible on-screen text. It supports multiple weights and likely enjoys an open license, making it appealing for UI designers.
items.summary_zh: Nebula Sans 是一个新字体家族，专为清晰的界面排版与屏幕阅读而设计，支持多种字重。它可能采用开源许可，适合 UI 设计师在不同平台上使用。

items.title_en: To become a better writer, read as much as you can
items.title_zh: 多读书，写作更好
items.summary_en: Advocates reading widely as the fastest path to improve writing, emphasizing deliberate reading, note-taking, and analyzing style. The piece offers practical steps to turn reading into better sentence craft and ideas.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张通过广泛阅读来提升写作能力，强调有目的的阅读、做笔记和分析风格的重要性，并给出将阅读转化为写作技巧的实用步骤。

items.title_en: The internet is kind of a predatory cesspit now
items.title_zh: 互联网如今有点成了掠夺性的泥潭
items.summary_en: Online spaces have devolved into predatory environments driven by monetization, harassment, and surveillance. The piece argues for stronger platform responsibility and safer design to curb these dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 在线空间已沦为由商业化、骚扰和监控驱动的掠夺性环境。文章主张加强平台责任与更安全的设计，以遏制这种动态。

items.title_en: Z.ai confirms Ox Alpha is a new GLM-series model and will release its weights
items.title_zh: Z.ai 确认 Ox Alpha 是新 GLM 系列模型，将发布权重
items.summary_en: Z.ai confirms that Ox Alpha is a new GLM-series model and will release its weights, signaling a push toward open-weight AI models and fiercer competition in the LLM space.
items.summary_zh: Z.ai 确认 Ox Alpha 是新的 GLM 系列模型，将发布权重，表明向开源权重模型迈进，激化了大型语言模型领域的竞争。

items.title_en: Good Culture Is the Biggest Productivity Hack, Not AI
items.title_zh: 良好文化才是最大的生产力秘诀，而非 AI
items.summary_en: Culture remains the biggest driver of productivity; AI alone won't compensate for lack of trust, clarity, and collaboration. The piece argues leaders should invest in culture—psychological safety, shared goals, and effective teamwork—to truly boost output.
items.summary_zh: 文化才是生产力的最大推动力，AI 工具若缺乏信任、清晰目标和协作也难以带来真正的产出提升。文章建议领导者把资源投入到文化建设上——营造心理安全、明确共同目标、高效协作，以实现生产力的倍增。

items.title_en: DHS is using obscure law to snoop on journalists, non-profits, unions
items.title_zh: DHS 利用冷门法律监视记者、非营利组织与工会
items.summary_en: New reporting shows DHS used an obscure summons power to obtain data on journalists, nonprofits, and unions, widening concerns about civil-liberties protections and government overreach. The piece underscores the chilling effect on press and civil-society work and calls for greater transparency and reform.
items.summary_zh: 最新报道揭示国土安全部利用一项冷门的传唤权调取记者、非营利组织和工会的数据，扩大了对公民自由与政府越权的担忧。该事件凸显对媒体与民间社会工作的震慑效应，并呼吁提高透明度与推进改革。

items.title_en: My agent.md to improve LLM-assisted code quality
items.title_zh: 我的 agent.md：提升 LLM 助力代码质量
items.summary_en: Proposes a structured 'agent.md' approach to guide LLM-assisted coding, using clear prompts, tool integration, and verification steps to raise code quality. It discusses building an autonomous agent that can plan, execute edits, and audit results, plus safety and reliability checks.
items.summary_zh: 提出将 agent.md 作为框架来组织 LLM 辅助编码，利用清晰的提示、工具集成和审核步骤提升代码质量。讨论构建具备计划、执行修改与结果审计能力的代理，以及安全与可靠性方面的考量。

items.title_en: Firefox 157 will include JPEG XL by default on all platforms
items.title_zh: Firefox 157 将在所有平台默认启用 JPEG XL
items.summary_en: Firefox 157 will ship with JPEG XL enabled by default on all platforms, expanding support for a more efficient image format and reducing wasteful image loading.
items.summary_zh: Firefox 157 将在所有平台默认启用 JPEG XL，提供更高效的图片格式并降低带宽与存储成本。

items.title_en: Boot a Virtual iPhone via Apple's Virtualization.framework
items.title_zh: 通过苹果的 Virtualization.framework 启动虚拟 iPhone
items.summary_en: A hobbyist demonstrates how to boot a virtual iPhone using Apple's Virtualization.framework, effectively running iOS as a VM on a host. The project shows the feasibility of isolating and testing iOS software without real hardware, unlocking new avenues for development, debugging, and security research. It remains experimental and depends on sensitive tooling and compliance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 开发者通过苹果的 Virtualization.framework 展示了如何引导一个虚拟 iPhone，在宿主机上运行 iOS 的虚拟机。该项目证明了在无实体设备的情况下测试和调试 iOS 的可行性，为开发、安全研究及隔离测试开辟新路径。此实现尚属实验性，且涉及工具与合规风险。

items.title_en: Asahi Linux Progress Report: Linux 7.2
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 进展报告：Linux 7.2
items.summary_en: Asahi Linux releases progress toward supporting Apple Silicon, with Linux 7.2 bringing improvements to boot, GPU, and performance on M1/M2 devices; ongoing work to mature drivers and userland experience.
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux 发布进展报告，聚焦在 Apple Silicon 上的 Linux 支持，Linux 7.2 带来引导、GPU 与性能等方面的改进，驱动与用户态体验仍在完善中。

items.title_en: A website for debloated open source alternatives
items.title_zh: 去臃肿的开源替代品网站
items.summary_en: Debloat.dev curates lighter, less feature-heavy open-source replacements for popular apps, aiming to reduce resource usage without sacrificing utility. The site helps users bypass bloatware and regain control over performance, privacy, and autonomy. For power users and older devices, it can be a practical shortcut to leaner software choices.
items.summary_zh: Debloat.dev 汇集了主流应用的更轻量、功能负担较低的开源替代品，目标是减少资源占用同时保留实用性。该站点帮助用户规避臃肿软件，提升性能、隐私与自主性。对于追求高效的高级用户和老旧设备，这是一条实用的替代路径。

items.title_en: Building a backyard office, the build and cost breakdown
items.title_zh: 打造后院办公室：施工与成本分解
items.summary_en: A real-world walkthrough of building a backyard office, detailing footprint, insulation, electrical work, HVAC, and material choices. The piece breaks down phased work and final costs, offering benchmarks for DIYers weighing a similar project. It also highlights productivity gains from eliminating commutes.
items.summary_zh: 对在自家后院建办公室的真实过程进行了分步解析，涵盖占地面积、隔热、电气、供暖制冷等要点与材料选择。文章给出施工阶段与最终成本的基准，帮助自助改造者评估类似项目的成本与可行性，同时强调省去通勤带来的生产力提升。

items.title_en: Lawmakers added $1 to car insurance policies. That money paid for Flock cameras
items.title_zh: 立法者在车险中多收1美元，用于资助Flock摄像头
items.summary_en: A modest insurance surcharge earmarked to fund Flock cameras reveals how state policy links private pricing with public surveillance infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 一笔用于资助 Flock 摄像头的车险附加费反映出政府将私人定价与公共监控基础设施连结的做法。文章讨论公共安全资金与消费者成本之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Just the rumour of a bug is enough to find an exploit these days
items.title_zh: 只凭传闻即可发现漏洞的时代
items.summary_en: Security researchers note that attackers can weaponize unverified bug rumors to craft exploits or pressure patch delays.
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用未证实的漏洞传闻就能催生利用方法，或逼迫厂商拖延修补。文章强调传闻驱动的利用风险，呼吁更强的披露机制和快速、可验证的修复。

items.title_en: Slovakia finds Russian backdoor in traffic speed cameras
items.title_zh: 斯洛伐克在交通测速摄像头中发现俄罗斯后门
items.summary_en: Slovakia detected a backdoor in Russian-made traffic speed cameras, potentially giving attackers remote access to live feeds and device data. The find highlights ongoing supply-chain risks in critical public infrastructure and the need for rigorous security audits and timely updates.
items.summary_zh: 斯洛伐克在一批俄罗斯制造的交通测速摄像头中发现后门，可能让攻击者获得远程访问摄像头数据。此事暴露了关键公共基础设施中的供应链风险，强调对相关设备进行严格的安全审计与及时更新的重要性。

items.title_en: Google Workspace thinks my domain is an email provider (2025)
items.title_zh: Google Workspace 把我的域名误判为邮件提供商
items.summary_en: Describes a misclassification by Google Workspace that labels a domain as an email provider, causing unexpected behavior in domain management and security settings.
items.summary_zh: 描述 Google Workspace 将某域名错误标注为电子邮件提供商，导致域名管理和安全设置方面出现异常。文中分析此错判对身份与托管配置的影响，以及对协作工作流的干扰。

items.title_en: Bug Blindness
items.title_zh: 漏洞盲点
items.summary_en: A deep dive into why developers consistently miss bugs, even in well-tested code, due to cognitive biases and organizational blind spots. The piece argues for stronger testability, structured debugging workflows, and diverse perspectives to counteract bug blindness.
items.summary_zh: 本文剖析开发者在经过多轮测试后仍漏掉缺陷的原因，源于认知偏差和组织层面的盲点。通过强调可测试性、结构化调试流程和多样化视角来对抗漏洞盲点。

items.title_en: How Complex Systems Fail (1998)
items.title_zh: 复杂系统如何失效（1998）
items.summary_en: The paper exposes how complex socio-technical systems fail through hidden interactions and cascading errors, not just individual faults. It argues for redesigns that emphasize safety culture, simple explanations for failures, and robust risk management—lessons that still apply to modern software and infrastructure. Understanding these dynamics helps teams anticipate cascades and improve resilience.
items.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了复杂社会技术系统如何通过隐藏的相互作用和级联错误而失败，而非仅仅是个别故障。它主张在设计上强调安全文化、对故障的简单解释以及强健的风险管理——这些教训至今仍适用于现代软件和基础设施。理解这些动力学有助于团队预测级联效应并提升韧性。

items.title_en: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.title_zh: Omarchy：任意用户进程均可提权至 Root
items.summary_en: A vulnerability dubbed Omarchy lets unprivileged user processes escalate to root in certain configurations. The write-up outlines the risk model, how escalation can occur, and what patches or mitigations are required to close the hole.
items.summary_zh: Omarchy 存在允许普通用户进程在特定配置下提权到 root 的漏洞。文章概述了风险场景、利用路径，以及修补与缓解措施。

items.title_en: Hy4 preview
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布并开源 Hy4 预览版
items.summary_en: Hy4 is Tencent's next large AI model with preview release and open-sourced components, expanding access to its latest AI stack. The move strengthens Tencent's position in the AI race and contributes to the broader open-source ecosystem, particularly for Chinese-language models and multimodal capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 腾讯发布了 Hy4 预览版并开源了核心组件，扩大了对其最新 AI 技术栈的接入。此举提升了腾讯在 AI 竞争中的地位，并为开放源生态做出贡献，特别是在中文模型与多模态能力方面。

items.title_en: I built a low-latency AI companion that plays Skyrim with me
items.title_zh: 我做了一个能和我一起玩《上古卷轴》的低延迟AI伙伴
items.summary_en: A low-latency AI companion that plays Skyrim with me demonstrates real-time in-game AI copilots. Leveraging optimized inference and streaming, it keeps up with fast gameplay, enabling a more interactive single-player experience. This kind of tech hints at future AI partners that can co-create with players.
items.summary_zh: 一个低延迟的AI伴侣可以与玩家在《上古卷轴》中实时互动，对战斗和探索提供即时协助。通过优化推理和实时流传输实现高响应性，提升单人游戏的沉浸感。这种技术暗示未来AI伙伴可能与玩家共同创造游戏体验。

items.title_en: Don't Wordle
items.title_zh: 不要玩 Wordle
items.summary_en: A playful site that encourages players to skip Wordle and explore other word games or puzzles. It illustrates how a single trend can spawn a cottage industry of alternatives and design experiments in the browser. The move spotlights the culture surrounding daily puzzle apps and user creativity.
items.summary_zh: 一个趣味性网站，鼓励玩家跳过 Wordle，尝试其他文字游戏或谜题，展示了热门潮流如何催生浏览器中的替代品与设计实验。此举映照出日常谜题应用的文化与用户创造力。

items.title_en: EVE Online moves to Python 3
items.title_zh: EVE Online 移动到 Python 3
items.summary_en: EVE Online moves its codebase to Python 3, reflecting the broader industry push to modernize Python 2-era backends. The migration highlights challenges around compatibility, performance, and live-service uptime in a large, live MMO.
items.summary_zh: EVE Online 将代码库迁移到 Python 3，体现了行业普遍向 Python 3 过渡的趋势。迁移在兼容性、性能与在线服务的连续性方面暴露了大型实时游戏后端的挑战。

items.title_en: IPFS Maintainers Winding Down
items.title_zh: IPFS 维护者开始退出维护工作
items.summary_en: IPFS maintainers are winding down operations, signaling a shift away from ongoing stewardship. The development raises questions about long-term data availability, community forks, and the future of decentralized storage tooling.
items.summary_zh: IPFS 的维护者开始逐步退出维护工作，标志着对持续维护的转变。此举引发关于长期数据可用性、社区分叉以及去中心化存储工具未来的讨论。

items.title_en: Gemini-3.5-Transcribe
items.title_zh: Gemini-3.5-Transcribe
items.summary_en: Gemini-3.5-Transcribe is a transcription-focused variant in Google's Gemini family, optimized for speech-to-text with accuracy and multilingual support. It signals continued emphasis on practical AI tools beyond chat, enabling developers to build better transcription and captioning apps.
items.summary_zh: Gemini-3.5-Transcribe 是谷歌 Gemini 系列中的一个专注转录任务的变体，针对语音转文字进行了优化，提升准确性并支持多语言。此举凸显了在对话之外的实用AI应用场景，便于开发者构建更出色的转写和字幕工具。

items.title_en: The turbulent AI era is here
items.title_zh: 动荡的 AI 时代已经到来
items.summary_en: Gates notes discuss how rapid AI advancements create a turbulent landscape and the critical governance, safety, and ethical choices leaders must make now. The piece emphasizes proactive planning and collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 盖茨在笔记中讨论了快速发展的 AI 所带来的动荡格局，以及领导者现在必须做出的治理、安全与伦理选择。文章强调前瞻性规划与跨界协作的重要性。

items.title_en: Where did all the public bathrooms go?
items.title_zh: 公共厕所去哪儿了？
items.summary_en: Public restrooms have vanished from many urban spaces, driven by funding cuts and policy priorities. The shortage creates practical challenges for travelers and residents, highlighting the social costs of urban design choices.
items.summary_zh: 在许多城市区域，公共厕所日渐稀缺，资金削减和政策取向是主要原因。厕所短缺给旅行者与居民带来实际困难，也凸显城市设计选择的社会代价。

items.title_en: Bomb fishing is wreaking havoc on Indonesia's coral reefs
items.title_zh: 炸药捕鱼正在严重破坏印尼珊瑚礁
items.summary_en: Dynamite fishing is devastating Indonesia’s coral reefs, causing widespread habitat loss and threatening livelihoods tied to reef ecosystems. The piece calls for stronger enforcement and alternative livelihoods, underscoring biodiversity loss and climate resilience concerns.
items.summary_zh: 炸药捕鱼正在严重破坏印尼的珊瑚礁，导致栖息地大量流失并威胁以珊瑚礁为生的生计。文章呼吁加强执法并提供替代生计，同时强调生物多样性损失与应对气候变化的长期韧性。

items.title_en: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟重新推动 ProtectEU 策略中的加密后门
items.summary_en: EU's ProtectEU revives calls for encryption backdoors to aid law enforcement, reigniting a broader debate on security vs. privacy. The piece outlines potential risks to security, freedom of expression, and the viability of secure communications if backdoors are mandated.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟在 ProtectEU 框架下重新推动对称/端对端加密的后门需求，引发关于安全与隐私的激烈辩论。若被强制实施，会对通信隐私与安全性造成长期风险，同时可能削弱整体系统的安全性。

items.title_en: What's new in Emacs 31.1
items.title_zh: Emacs 31.1 的新特性
items.summary_en: Emacs 31.1 ships with a raft of enhancements, including UI and workflow improvements, and better Lisp tooling. The update nudges the editor toward smoother developer workflows while maintaining its extensible, text-focused ethos.
items.summary_zh: Emacs 31.1 带来一系列增强，包括用户界面、工作流改进，以及更好的 Lisp 工具支持。此次更新让编辑器在保持可扩展、文本为本的理念的同时，为开发者工作流带来更顺畅的体验。

items.title_en: OpenAI: GPT 5.6 Sol price reduction (until at least Nov 21)
items.title_zh: OpenAI：GPT-5.6 Sol 价降低（至至少 11 月 21 日）
items.summary_en: OpenAI is offering a price cut on GPT-5.6 Sol API usage through at least November 21, lowering the cost for developers piloting higher-cost models. The discount may influence project timelines, experimentation, and pricing strategies for startups and researchers.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 使用价格上调低，至少持续到 11 月 21 日，降低了使用高成本模型的门槛。此举可能影响项目时间表、试验节奏以及初创企业和研究者的定价策略。

items.title_en: I gave Qwen 3.8 27B a reverse-engineering job and it finished in 30 minutes
items.title_zh: 我给 Qwen 3.8 27B 指派做反向工程任务，30 分钟就完成
items.summary_en: Hands-on test shows a 27B LLM can perform a reverse-engineering task quickly, highlighting AI assistance for code analysis and problem solving. It demonstrates potential speedups in tasks like malware analysis or binary comprehension, while reminding that verification and safety checks remain essential.
items.summary_zh: 亲身测试显示 Qwen 3.8 27B 能在短时间内完成反向工程任务，展现了 AI 对代码分析与问题求解的辅助潜力。虽然可能带来分析效率的提升，但仍需谨慎验证并注意安全与准确性。

items.title_en: Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
items.title_zh: 冰岛就重新开启加入欧盟谈判进行投票
items.summary_en: Iceland is weighing a restart of EU accession talks, signaling renewed attention to Brussels-style integration. The vote could shape regulatory alignment, fisheries policy, and energy markets as Iceland decides its stance toward potential membership.
items.summary_zh: 冰岛正就重新开启对欧盟的入盟谈判进行投票，凸显对布鲁塞尔式一体化的重新关注。此举可能影响监管对齐、渔业政策与能源市场，对潜在入盟的路径选取产生影响。

items.title_en: The turbulent AI era is here
items.title_zh: 混乱的AI时代已经到来
items.summary_en: Bill Gates discusses the disruptive AI landscape and critical choices for society, business, and policy. It highlights the need for pragmatic governance, safety, and inclusive access.
items.summary_zh: 比尔·盖茨在其文章中讨论了颠覆性的 AI 生态和社会、商业与政策层面的关键抉择，强调务实治理、安全性与包容性的重要性。

items.title_en: Queryable Executables
items.title_zh: 可查询的可执行文件
items.summary_en: Queryable Executables explores making binaries self-describing and introspectable, enabling easier debugging, tracing, and tooling around compiled programs.
items.summary_zh: 可查询的可执行文件探讨让二进制文件具备自描述和可自检能力，从而简化调试、追踪和相关工具的使用。

items.title_en: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 事件及未来方向
items.summary_en: The piece reviews a notable incident at Hugging Face and outlines a path forward focusing on governance, security, and responsible AI collaboration. It emphasizes balancing openness with safety and compliance.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了 Hugging Face 的一起重要事件，并提出未来的治理、安全与负责任的 AI 合作方向，强调在开放性与安全合规之间寻求平衡。

items.title_en: Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next releasing tomorrow (125B a6B)
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next 将于明日发布（125B 参数）
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next is set to release tomorrow, featuring a 125B-parameter model in the Qwen lineup. The release adds to the growing competition in large language models and showcases Flash-optimized deployment options.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next 将于明日发布，提供 1250 亿参数规模的模型，继续推动大模型竞争并展示针对 Flash 架构的部署选项。

items.title_en: CoMaps: The Offline App That Guided Rescuers Without a Signal in Venezuela
items.title_zh: CoMaps：在委内瑞拉无信号时引导救援的离线应用
items.summary_en: CoMaps is an offline mapping app used in Venezuela to guide rescuers when mobile networks fail. The project demonstrates how offline GIS tools can enable rapid humanitarian response in connectivity-challenged emergencies.
items.summary_zh: CoMaps 是一款离线地图应用，在委内瑞拉无信号时为救援人员提供路线指引。该项目展示了离线 GIS 工具在网络受限的紧急救援中对快速响应的贡献。

items.title_en: Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful, US judge rules
items.title_zh: 五角大楼对 Anthropic 的黑名单被判违法
items.summary_en: U.S. Judge ruled the Pentagon's blacklist of Anthropic unlawful, ordering the government to halt the measure. The ruling limits the executive branch's ability to blacklist vendors and could influence future defense AI procurement practices.
items.summary_zh: 法官裁定五角大楼对 Anthropic 的黑名单违法，责令政府停止该措施。判决限制政府在供应商黑名单方面的权力，并可能影响未来的国防AI采购流程。

items.title_en: Zohran and the Short Link
items.title_zh: Zohran 与短链接
items.summary_en: Zohran and the Short Link examines how a political note intersects with the limitations and affordances of URL shorteners in modern online messaging.
items.summary_zh: 《Zohran 与短链接》探讨在现代在线传播中，短链接工具的局限性与可能带来的传播效应。

items.title_en: Wi-Fi 8 is the first wireless upgrade in years that isn't chasing speed
items.title_zh: Wi-Fi 8：多年升级不再全力追求速度
items.summary_en: Wi-Fi 8 shifts priorities from raw speed toward reliability, coverage, energy efficiency, and security features amid rising smart home needs.
items.summary_zh: Wi‑Fi 8 将优先关注可靠性、覆盖、能效与安全性等特性，而非追逐更高速度，适应物联网家庭需求。

items.title_en: France reaches 94.9% fiber coverage in 2026
items.title_zh: 法国在2026年实现94.9%光纤覆盖率
items.summary_en: France closes in on universal broadband with 94.9% fiber coverage in 2026, reflecting ongoing efforts by regulators and operators. While the reach is high, rural gaps persist, keeping the push for nationwide gigabit access on the agenda.
items.summary_zh: 法国在2026年实现了94.9%的光纤覆盖率，显示监管与运营商在推进普惠宽带方面取得显著进展。尽管覆盖面广，偏远地区的接入差距仍然存在，普及千兆网的目标仍在继续。

items.title_en: Glacier Mice
items.title_zh: 冰川苔球现象
items.summary_en: Glacier Mice are moss-covered stones that drift across ice sheets, propelled by wind and thermal updrafts. They illustrate micro-ecosystem dynamics in extreme environments and offer a quirky example of how life survives on moving glacial surfaces.
items.summary_zh: 冰川苔球是在冰川上由苔藓覆盖的石块，受风和地热上升气流驱动缓慢移动。这一现象揭示极端环境中的微型生态系统动力学，为研究生物地理与微栖息地提供有趣案例。

items.title_en: The Twelve-Factor App (2025)
items.title_zh: 十二因子应用原则
items.summary_en: An established methodology for building SaaS apps that are portable and maintainable. It codifies best practices around config, dependencies, backing services, build/run release, logs, and parity between development and production environments.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向 SaaS 应用的成熟架构方法论，强调应用配置、依赖、后端服务、构建/运行/发布、日志，以及开发和生产环境的一致性等最佳实践。

items.title_en: GrapheneOS project: pixel 11 no longer supports hardware memory tagging (MTE)
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 项目：Pixel 11 不再支持硬件内存标记（MTE）
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS notes that Pixel 11 devices no longer support hardware memory tagging (MTE), a feature that enhances memory safety. Dropping MTE reduces built-in protections, illustrating the tension between device compatibility and security in open-source mobile OS projects.
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS 指出 Pixel 11 不再支持硬件内存标记（MTE），这一特性有助于提升内存安全。移除 MTE 会降低内置保护，凸显在开源移动操作系统中，兼容性与安全性之间的权衡。

items.title_en: I accidentally turned LLM memory into program analysis
items.title_zh: 我不小心把大语言模型记忆变成了程序分析工具
items.summary_en: A personal project reveals that persistent attention memory in large language models can be repurposed for static and dynamic program analysis tasks. By treating the model's remembered state as a proxy for program state, the author demonstrates new debugging workflows, memory-safe reasoning, and potential tooling shifts for developers.
items.summary_zh: 作者偶然发现把大语言模型的记忆用于程序分析成为可能，为静态与动态分析任务提供新思路。通过把模型记忆映射到程序状态，展示了新的调试流程、内存安全推理，以及对开发工具链潜在的影响。

items.title_en: Anna's Archive Owes $340 Million, Lost Several Domains, but It's Still Online
items.title_zh: Anna's Archive 欠款 3.4 亿美元，但仍在线
items.summary_en: Anna’s Archive owes about $340 million and lost several domains, yet the site remains accessible. The case illustrates how large debts and domain seizures intersect with continued availability, raising questions about funding, hosting, and preservation of digital content.
items.summary_zh: Anna’s Archive 欠款约 3.4 亿美元，且损失了若干域名，但站点仍可访问。此事揭示了巨额债务与域名没收如何与持续可用性交汇，并引发对资金、托管及数字内容保存的讨论。

items.title_en: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
items.title_zh: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
items.summary_en: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash updates likely bring improved tooling, faster deployment, and better integration with Gemini models for developers. It signals ongoing investments in developer experience around Google's Gemini platform.
items.summary_zh: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 更新带来更完善的开发工具链、更快的部署和对 Gemini 模型的更好集成，反映出谷歌在 Gemini 平台上持续打磨开发者体验。

items.title_en: Taylor Farms: How One Company's Reach Became a National Risk
items.title_zh: Taylor Farms：一个公司影响力如何成为全国性风险
items.summary_en: A Farm Action report argues that Taylor Farms' scale and supplier network create systemic risks to food supply, workers’ rights, and market competition. The piece calls for greater transparency and regulatory oversight.
items.summary_zh: Farm Action 的报告认为 Taylor Farms 的规模与供应链网络会带来食品供应、劳工权益和市场竞争的系统性风险。该文呼吁提高透明度并加强监管。

items.title_en: Casey Muratori – The Root of the Root of All Evil – BSC 2026 [video]
items.title_zh: Casey Muratori——万恶之源的根源——BSC 2026 [视频]
items.summary_en: Casey Muratori's BSC 2026 talk digs into systemic issues behind software fragility and how reliance on hidden caches, build processes, and vendor ecosystems compounds risk. It makes a case for simpler, auditable tooling and practices.
items.summary_zh: Casey Muratori 在 BSC 2026 的演讲聚焦软件生态中的脆弱性根源，以及隐藏的构建过程和依赖链如何放大风险。呼吁回归简单、可审计的工具与工作方式。

items.title_en: Over 170k Nonprofits Lost All Their Data. Is Microsoft to Blame?
items.title_zh: 超过17万家非营利组织丢失全部数据：微软该负责吗？
items.summary_en: Reports a large-scale data loss affecting more than 170k nonprofits, raising questions about data retention policies and risk management for cloud services. The piece analyzes responsibility, data portability, and the need for better backups and vendor accountability.
items.summary_zh: 报道超过十七万家非营利组织遭遇数据全部丢失，引发对云端服务的数据保留策略和风险管理的质疑。文章分析责任归属、数据可携带性，以及提升备份与供应商问责制的需求。

items.title_en: Brits would quite like their private messages to stay private
items.title_zh: 英国人希望私信保持私密
items.summary_en: Poll results suggest Brits want stronger privacy protections for private messages, reflecting concerns about law-enforcement access and metadata. The discussion hints at potential political pressure for messaging-app privacy features.
items.summary_zh: 民意调查显示英国人希望私密消息获得更强保护，反映对执法访问和元数据的担忧。讨论暗示可能推动在消息应用隐私功能上的政治压力。

items.title_en: RISC-V is now officially supported by CPython
items.title_zh: CPython 正式支持 RISC-V
items.summary_en: CPython now officially supports RISC-V, expanding Python adoption on the RISC-V ecosystem. This brings official builds and better portability for developers on open hardware, including embedded and hobbyist boards.
items.summary_zh: CPython 现正式支持 RISC-V，扩大了在 RISC-V 生态系统中的 Python 采纳度。这为使用开源硬件的开发者，尤其是在嵌入式和爱好者板上，带来官方构建与更好的可移植性。

items.title_en: Omarchy development practices lead to predictable security issues
items.title_zh: Omarchy 的开发实践导致可预见的安全问题
items.summary_en: A critique of Omarchy-style development shows recurring security flaws rooted in common patterns and defaults. The piece argues for security-by-design, better supply-chain hygiene, and proactive threat modeling to break the cycle.
items.summary_zh: 对 Omarchy 风格开发模式的批评指出，常见模式和默认设置会带来重复性的安全漏洞。文章主张从设计之初考虑安全、加强供应链治理并进行前瞻性威胁建模，以打破恶性循环。

items.title_en: We found a division by zero bug in FFmpeg with a vibecoded fuzzer
items.title_zh: 我们在 FFmpeg 的 vibecoded fuzz 测试中发现除零错误
items.summary_en: A vibecoded fuzzer uncovered a division-by-zero bug in FFmpeg, potentially causing crashes or exploit paths in media processing. The finding highlights ongoing importance of fuzzing and robust error handling in critical multimedia tooling.
items.summary_zh: 一次 vibecoded 模糊测试在 FFmpeg 中发现除零错误，可能触发崩溃或引入利用路径，影响音视频处理的稳定性。此发现强调了对关键多媒体工具持续进行模糊测试和鲁棒性改进的重要性。

items.title_en: Black hole singularity is a surface not a point
items.title_zh: 黑洞奇点是一个表面，而非点
items.summary_en: A new theoretical proposal suggests treating the black hole singularity as a surface rather than a point, rethinking the extreme geometry where gravity dominates. If correct, the idea could influence how we model spacetime at quantum scales and challenge long-held assumptions about information loss and singularities.
items.summary_zh: 一个理论性提议将黑洞奇点描述为一个曲面而非点，重新思考在极端密度下引力支配的几何结构。若成立，这一观点可能影响在量子尺度上对时空的建模，并挑战关于信息丢失与奇点的长期假设。

items.title_en: XCancel and Nitter are receiving C&D letters from XCorp
items.title_zh: XCorp 向 XCancel 与 Nitter 发出停止令
items.summary_en: XCorp is sending cease-and-desist notices to third-party frontends like XCancel and Nitter that access the platform. The move highlights tension between platform-controlled APIs and open web interfaces, with implications for developers who rely on alternate access points.
items.summary_zh: XCorp 向第三方前端 XCancel 与 Nitter 发出停止令，限制其对 X 平台的访问。这一举动凸显平台端 API 控制与开放前端之间的矛盾，对依赖替代访问点的开发者产生影响。

items.title_en: Suica, Japan's First IC Transit Card
items.title_zh: Suica：日本首张 IC 交通卡
items.summary_en: The article traces Suica's origin as Japan's first contactless IC transit card and its impact on urban mobility. It highlights the technology choices, adoption, and how it catalyzed mobile wallet integration and nationwide transit networks.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾日本首张 IC 交通卡 Suica 的诞生及其对城市出行的影响，介绍了技术选择、普及过程，以及推动移动钱包和全国性交通网络发展的作用。

items.title_en: FDA approves first in class targeted therapy for metastatic pancreatic cancer
items.title_zh: FDA 批准首个同类靶向治疗用于转移性胰腺癌
items.summary_en: FDA approves a first-in-class targeted therapy for metastatic pancreatic cancer, marking progress in precision oncology. The approval is based on targeting a specific mutation and could expand treatment options for patients with this aggressive cancer.
items.summary_zh: FDA 批准了首个同类靶向治疗用于转移性胰腺癌，代表精准肿瘤治疗的一步进展。该药物针对特定突变，或为这类晚期患者带来新的治疗选项。

items.title_en: My favorite nonfiction books about cults, scams, and schemes
items.title_zh: 我最喜欢的关于邪教、骗局和阴谋的非虚构书籍
items.summary_en: Curated nonfiction works about cults, scams, and schemes, offering deep dives into manipulation, social psychology, and fraud. The selections help readers recognize misinformation, understand how scams unfold, and improve critical thinking for evaluating tech hype and online narratives.
items.summary_zh: 精选关于邪教、骗局与阴谋的非虚构著作，深入探讨操控、社会心理与欺诈机制。帮助读者提升识别错误信息的能力，理解骗局如何运作，并在评估科技领域的热点话题和网络叙事时保持清醒判断。

items.title_en: Worst-case glacial lake flood scenarios in a transboundary Himalayan basin 2022
items.title_zh: 跨境喜马拉雅盆地的最坏情况冰川湖洪水情景（2022）
items.summary_en: The 2022 study models worst-case glacial-lake flood scenarios in a transboundary Himalayan basin, highlighting potential cross-border impacts and the need for regional risk management and early warning systems in the context of climate change.
items.summary_zh: 该研究对跨境喜马拉雅盆地的冰川湖洪水极端情景进行了建模，揭示了潜在的跨境影响以及区域协作与预警系统在气候变化背景下的必要性。

items.title_en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
items.title_zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜
items.summary_en: NASA's Roman Space Telescope will use a wide-field infrared imager to study dark energy and exoplanets at unprecedented survey scales. It represents a major leap for space astronomy, delivering large-scale cosmic maps that complement JWST and ground-based surveys.
items.summary_zh: 美国国家航空航天局的罗曼太空望远镜将使用广域红外成像仪进行大规模的宇宙勘测，着眼于暗能量与系外行星的统计学研究。该任务标志着天文观测的一个重大跃进，所取得的大范围宇宙图像将与 JWST 及地面观测互为补充。

items.title_en: Doctors are finally learning to manage antidepressant withdrawal
items.title_zh: 医生终于学会应对抗抑郁药戒断
items.summary_en: Antidepressant withdrawal symptoms have long been underappreciated. Clinicians are adopting slower taper protocols, better monitoring, and supportive care to reduce harm during discontinuation.
items.summary_zh: 长期以来，抗抑郁药戒断症状被低估。医生现在采用更温和的减药方案、加强监测并提供综合支持，以降低戒断带来的风险。

items.title_en: Samsung's Processing-in-Memory (PIM)
items.title_zh: 三星的内存就近处理（PIM）技术
items.summary_en: Samsung showcased its Processing-in-Memory (PIM) approach at Hot Chips 2026, aiming to move compute closer to DRAM to cut data movement. The prototypes emphasize near-memory accelerators and lightweight logic inside memory arrays, targeting AI and high-performance workloads with better throughput and energy efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 三星在 2026 年 Hot Chips 会议上展示了其内存就近处理（PIM）方案，意在把计算带到接近 DRAM 的位置以减少数据搬运。该方案在内存阵列中嵌入近存加速单元和简化逻辑，面向 AI 等工作负载提升吞吐与能效潜力。

items.title_en: Starbase, LA
items.title_zh: 洛杉矶的 Starbase
items.summary_en: Starbase, LA updates provide insight into SpaceX's activities around a Starbase facility in Los Angeles, including infrastructure developments, testing, and local approvals.
items.summary_zh: 洛杉矶的 Starbase 最新进展揭示 SpaceX 在该地区的基地相关基础建设、测试活动与当地监管进展。

items.title_en: How much of HN is AI?
items.title_zh: Hacker News 上有多大比例在谈 AI？
items.summary_en: An analysis of how much of Hacker News discussions are AI-related, indicating AI's dominant presence in tech discourse and potential implications for readers and product teams.
items.summary_zh: 对 Hacker News 讨论中 AI 相关内容的比例进行分析，显示 AI 在科技话题中的主导地位，并对读者与产品团队的关注点产生影响。

items.title_en: Jabber/XMPP: 25 Years of Digital Independence
items.title_zh: Jabber/XMPP：25 年的数字独立性
items.summary_en: XMPP marks 25 years of federated, interoperable messaging that preserves user control over communications. The retrospective highlights the resilience of open protocols in an era of centralized platforms and discusses implications for privacy-focused messaging.
items.summary_zh: XMPP 走过 25 年的对等、互通式消息传递历史，保持对用户通讯的控制权。回顾强调开放协议在中心化平台盛行的时代的韧性，并讨论对隐私导向通信的影响。

items.title_en: Kusama Yayoi has died
items.title_zh: 草间弥生去世
items.summary_en: Yayoi Kusama, the iconic Japanese artist known for immersive installations and polka dots, has died, ending a prolific career that reshaped contemporary art. Her influence persists across museums, fashion, and pop culture.
items.summary_zh: 草间弥生，被沉浸式装置与标志性圆点所知的传奇日本艺术家去世，标志着她跨越多年的高产生涯告一段落。她的影响力仍在全球博物馆、时尚与大众文化中延续。

items.title_en: Decompiling a Nintendo 64 game in 84 days
items.title_zh: 84 天破解任天堂 64 游戏
items.summary_en: A project documents the journey of reverse-engineering and decompiling a Nintendo 64 game within 84 days, detailing tooling, code reconstruction, and learnings for retro game hacking.
items.summary_zh: 记录了在 84 天内对任天堂 64 游戏进行逆向工程与反编译的历程，涵盖所用工具、代码重建过程及对复古游戏破解的经验教训。

items.title_en: Moon (2024)
items.title_zh: Moon (2024)
items.summary_en: Moon (2024) is a project exploring lunar-themed visuals.
items.summary_zh: Moon（2024）是一项围绕月球主题的可视化探索项目。

items.title_en: Malware infects Android-based automotive head unit firmware
items.title_zh: Android 汽车中控固件被木马感染
items.summary_en: Malware has compromised an Android-based automotive head unit, showing that infotainment firmware can be a doorway into a car's ecosystem. The attack likely leverages insecure update pathways or compromised apps, enabling persistence and potential control of connected features. This case underscores the need for stronger supply-chain security, code signing, and robust OTA verification in modern vehicles.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现基于 Android 的汽车中控固件被木马入侵，显现信息娱乐系统也可能成为进入车载生态的入口。攻击链可能利用不安全的更新机制或被篡改的应用，从而实现持久化和对连接功能的潜在控制。这凸显了在现代汽车中加强供应链安全、代码签名和鲁棒 OTA 验证的重要性。

items.title_en: Disruption with Some GitHub Services – Resolved
items.title_zh: 部分 GitHub 服务中断已解决
items.summary_en: A partial outage affected a subset of GitHub services; the incident has been resolved. The event underscores the fragility of cloud-based developer tooling and the importance of status transparency and resilience planning.
items.summary_zh: 部分 GitHub 服务曾发生中断，现已修复。事件凸显云端开发工具的脆弱性，也再次强调透明的状态通报和系统韧性的重要性。

items.title_en: Sovereign Tech Agency invests €500k in Flatpak
items.title_zh: Sovereign Tech Agency 投资 €500k 在 Flatpak
items.summary_en: Investment funds Flatpak development, signaling continued support for Linux app sandboxing and cross-distro packaging, reinforcing open-source distribution.
items.summary_zh: Sovereign Tech Agency 投资 €500k 于 Flatpak，支持 Linux 应用沙箱化和跨发行版打包，强化开源软件的分发生态。

items.title_en: Hilariously fast volume computation with the divergence theorem (2018)
items.title_zh: 用散度定理实现的极快体积计算
items.summary_en: A blog post reveals a surprisingly fast way to compute the volume of complex shapes using the divergence theorem. By reducing volume to facet- and vertex-based sums, it enables nearly instant estimates from mesh data, with potential benefits for graphics, physics, and CAD workloads.
items.summary_zh: 一篇博文展示了通过应用散度定理来实现对复杂形状体积的极快计算方法。该方法把体积转化为对面的数量和顶点的简单运算，从网格数据中即可得到近似的即时体积结果，这对图形学、物理仿真和 CAD 工作流都可能带来显著收益。

items.title_en: Stalking the Wily Hacker: 40 years later – Cliff Stoll [video]
items.title_zh: 40年后再追踪狡猾的黑客：Cliff Stoll [视频]
items.summary_en: Cliff Stoll’s 1980s pursuit of a hacker helped shape modern cybersecurity. In a new video, he reflects on the evolution of threats from lone intruders to organized criminal and state actors, and what defenders can still learn from his experience. The talk frames enduring lessons about vigilance, quick detection, and credible forensics.
items.summary_zh: 克利夫·斯托尔在上世纪80年代追踪黑客的经历推动了现代网络安全的发展。最新视频中，他反思了从个人入侵者到有组织的犯罪和国家行为者的威胁演变，以及防御者仍可从其经历中汲取的教训。演讲强调警觉、快速检测与可信取证等长期要点。

items.title_en: Hacking IKEA Furniture
items.title_zh: 改装 IKEA 家具
items.summary_en: A DIY guide shows how to hack Ikea furniture to add electronics or customization. It demonstrates affordable, modular DIY that can extend the life and utility of everyday furniture.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份关于如何改装 Ikea 家具以加入电子元件或自定义功能的动手指南，展示了低成本、模块化的 DIY 思路，能延长日常家具的使用价值。

items.title_en: GitHub Outage Tracker: Is GitHub Cooked?
items.title_zh: GitHub 宕机追踪器：GitHub 是否出了大问题？
items.summary_en: Outage tracker aggregates incidents and uptime data for GitHub, raising questions about the reliability of essential dev tooling and how teams plan for outages.
items.summary_zh: 该站点汇总 GitHub 的宕机事件与可用性数据，强调开发者工具的可靠性以及团队在面对不可用时的应对策略。

items.title_en: EPA says power for data centers can sidestep pollution laws
items.title_zh: EPA 表示数据中心的供电可规避污染法规
items.summary_en: EPA issued guidance suggesting data-center power procurement could fall outside certain pollution-permitting requirements. The move aims to accelerate deployment but faces environmental scrutiny.
items.summary_zh: EPA 指导数据中心在用电方面的合规界限明晰，某些供电方案可能规避传统污染许可要求，以加速部署，但引发环境监管关注。

items.title_en: New EU-wide product repair rules come into force
items.title_zh: 欧盟范围的新产品维修规则已生效
items.summary_en: New EU repair rules take effect, aiming to improve product longevity and reduce waste across the bloc. Expect requirements around spare parts availability, repair information, and consumer rights that empower independent repair shops and users.
items.summary_zh: 覆盖欧盟的新维修规则开始生效，旨在提升产品寿命、降低电子垃圾。规则将要求提供易得的备件、可获取的修理信息，并加强消费者对维修的权利，推动独立维修市场。

items.title_en: SQLite as a Document Database (2020)
items.title_zh: SQLite 作为文档数据库（2020）
items.summary_en: SQLite has long been a relational DB, but with JSON1 and related features you can model document-like data inside SQLite. The piece surveys practical patterns for storing, indexing, and querying JSON documents in SQLite, showing how it can act as a lightweight document store for local apps without a separate NoSQL layer.
items.summary_zh: SQLite 长期以关系型数据库著称，但借助 JSON1 等特性，仍可在其中建模文档型数据。文章给出在 SQLite 中存储、索引与查询 JSON 文档的实用模式，展示其在本地应用中充当轻量级文档存储的可行性与取舍。

items.title_en: Stripe acquires Clerky
items.title_zh: Stripe 收购 Clerky
items.summary_en: Stripe expands entrepreneurial tooling by acquiring Clerky, boosting its startup formation and compliance offerings; Clerky's automation for filings and KYC will integrate with Stripe's payments and treasury tools, accelerating onboarding for startups.
items.summary_zh: Stripe 收购 Clerky，增强对初创企业成立和合规的工具链。Clerky 的文书自动化与合规流程将与 Stripe 的支付与资金管理工具深度整合，加速初创企业的上线流程。

items.title_en: It’s so hard to finish an idea that is not yours and is just suggested by AI
items.title_zh: 以 AI 提示的创意难以完成：非原创想法的落地经验
items.summary_en: An essay argues that finishing ideas not originated by you and largely driven by AI is tough, touching on ownership, authorship, and the friction of integrating AI-generated concepts into live projects.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，完成非你原创且由 AI 提示却成形的创意很困难，涉及所有权、署名及将 AI 生成的想法落地时的阻力。

items.title_en: US Government designates host of noblogs.org a "global terrorist"
items.title_zh: 美国政府将 noblogs.org 的托管方列为全球恐怖主义实体
items.summary_en: The U.S. government designated the host of noblogs.org as a global terrorist, a move that can disrupt fundraising, hosting, and access for the site. The designation reflects the expanding use of-terrorist labels in internet infrastructure disputes and raises questions about due process.
items.summary_zh: 美国政府将 noblogs.org 的托管方定性为全球恐怖主义实体，可能影响资金、托管与域名等运营活动。此举凸显互联网基础设施标签化执法的趋势，也引发对程序正当性的讨论。

items.title_en: Fake US thinktank set up and funded by Israel sought to game AI for propaganda
items.title_zh: 由以色列资助的假想智库企图利用 AI 进行宣传
items.summary_en: A fake think tank allegedly funded by Israel attempted to push AI-generated propaganda and manipulate public discourse. The case illustrates how AI can be leveraged in influence operations and the need for provenance checks and media literacy in the information ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 一假想智库据称受到以色列资助，企图利用 AI 生成宣传内容以影响舆论。事件揭示了人工智能在信息战中的潜在风险，凸显对信息来源溯源和提升媒体素养的必要性。

items.title_en: Europe's summer drought is so extreme that desertification is a growing threat
items.title_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱极端化，沙漠化风险上升
items.summary_en: Europe's summer drought reached extreme levels, stressing rivers, crops, and ecosystems and raising desertification risks across the continent.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱达到极端水平，威胁河流、农作物和生态系统并提升沙漠化风险。报道聚焦气候影响、水资源管理挑战以及政策应对。

items.title_en: How Universities Should Prepare Founders
items.title_zh: 高校应如何培养创业者
items.summary_en: Paul Graham argues universities should actively prepare founders, aligning curricula and mentorship with the realities of startup building. The piece advocates practical entrepreneurship education and better pathways for student-led ventures.
items.summary_zh: 保罗·格雷厄姆认为高校应积极为创始人做准备，使课程、导师制与初创企业现实需求对齐，倡导以实践为导向的创业教育和更好的学生创业路径。

items.title_en: GLM-5.3 (open-weight) beat Anthropic/OpenAI models – for 1/5 the cost
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3（开源权重）以五分之一成本击败 Anthropic/OpenAI 模型
items.summary_en: GLM-5.3 open-weight outperforms Anthropic and OpenAI models while costing only about one-fifth as much. The result demonstrates the viability of open-weight LLMs for cost-sensitive applications and could shift enterprise procurement and research economics.
items.summary_zh: GLM-5.3开源权重在成本仅约五分之一的情况下，超越了Anthropic和OpenAI的模型。此结果凸显开源大模型在成本敏感场景中的可行性，可能影响企业采购策略和研究经济学。

items.title_en: XCancel also down, at least for time being
items.title_zh: XCancel 暂时宕机，至少暂时无法使用
items.summary_en: XCancel is down for the time being, illustrating how third-party front-ends relying on platform APIs can be fragile in times of platform outages or policy shifts.
items.summary_zh: XCancel 暂时宕机，说明依赖平台 API 的第三方前端在平台故障或策略变动时容易受影响。

items.title_en: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
items.title_zh: Haiku R1/beta6 已发布
items.summary_en: Haiku OS releases R1/beta6, marking another step toward a stable, BeOS-inspired operating system. The beta focuses on hardware compatibility, performance improvements, and developer tooling as the community works toward a more complete 1.0.
items.summary_zh: Haiku OS 发布了 R1 的 beta6 版，向着稳定版又迈进一步。该版本在提升硬件兼容性、性能改进和开发工具方面做出努力，社区期待更完整的 1.0。

items.title_en: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
items.title_zh: StemDeck：免费开源、在本地运行的 AI 音轨分离工具
items.summary_en: StemDeck offers free, open-source AI-driven audio stem separation that runs locally on your machine. By processing offline, it avoids cloud privacy concerns and can leverage your hardware for faster results, making it attractive for musicians and audio engineers exploring stem remixing.
items.summary_zh: StemDeck 提供免费、开源的 AI 音轨分离工具，能够在本地计算机上离线运行。避免云端传输带来的隐私风险，并能充分利用本地硬件提升处理速度，成为音乐人和音频工程师进行分轨再混音的有力工具。

items.title_en: Show HN: A techno machine in one HTML file, with verifiable renders
items.title_zh: Show HN：单个 HTML 文件中的技术机器，提供可验证的渲染
items.summary_en: Show HN presents a techno machine entirely in a single HTML file, delivering verifiable renders without relying on external assets. It demonstrates how self-contained web tech can produce reproducible, tamper-evident demos.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了一个完全用一个 HTML 文件实现的技术机器，提供可验证的渲染且无需外部资源。它展示了自包含网页技术在可重复且不可篡改演示中的可行性。

items.title_en: Peppermint oil reduces blood pressure by 8.48 mmHg in small study
items.title_zh: 薄荷油可降低血压的初步研究
items.summary_en: A small study finds peppermint oil may reduce systolic blood pressure by about 8.5 mmHg, hinting at potential complementary therapy for hypertension. More extensive trials are needed to establish efficacy and safety.
items.summary_zh: 一项小规模研究发现薄荷油可能将收缩压降低约 8.5 毫米汞柱，提示其作为高血压辅助治疗的潜力。需要更大规模的试验来确立疗效与安全性。

items.title_en: How credit card rewards became a $9.2B wealth transfer
items.title_zh: 信用卡奖励如何成为92亿美元的财富转移
items.summary_en: The economics of credit-card rewards programs show why they transfer billions in value among issuers, merchants, and consumers. The article breaks down how points, fees, and partnerships create a multi-billion-dollar reshuffling of wealth.
items.summary_zh: 信用卡奖励计划背后的经济学揭示了为何会在发行方、商户和消费者之间发生数十亿美元的财富再分配。文章解析了积分、手续费和合作关系如何推动这场价值再分配。

items.title_en: Fable and the end of the free lunch
items.title_zh: Fable 与免费午餐时代的终结
items.summary_en: Argues that the era of 'free lunch'—easy, cheap AI progress—may be ending as hardware, data, and energy costs scale with model improvements. It weighs bottlenecks and suggests a shift toward more efficient architectures, smarter training, and software optimization to keep AI advancing affordably.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，依赖简单、廉价的 AI 进步的“免费午餐”时代似乎结束，硬件、数据与能耗成本在模型规模扩张中上升。文中讨论了瓶颈，并提出更高效的架构、更聪明的训练以及软件优化以维持经济可行的AI发展。

items.title_en: Show HN: OpenTIE and OpenXWA, Modern Ports of Tie Fighter and X-Wing Alliance
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenTIE 与 OpenXWA，现代移植的 Tie Fighter 与 X-Wing Alliance
items.summary_en: OpenTIE and OpenXWA bring classic Star Wars flight sims to modern systems with community-driven ports. These projects extend preservation and modding opportunities, attracting retro gaming enthusiasts while testing the limits of open-source remakes.
items.summary_zh: OpenTIE 与 OpenXWA 将经典星球大战飞行模拟游戏带到现代系统，完全由社区驱动的移植。项目拓展了游戏保存与 modding 的空间，吸引复古游戏爱好者，也检验了开源复刻的潜力与边界。

items.title_en: EasyEffects can improve laptop speaker sound quality
items.title_zh: EasyEffects 能极大提升笔记本扬声器音质
items.summary_en: Linux audio tool EasyEffects can drastically improve built-in laptop speakers by enabling advanced DSP, EQ, and routing options. The piece argues it should be standard in distributions for better out-of-the-box sound.
items.summary_zh: Linux 音频工具 EasyEffects 通过启用高级数字信号处理、均衡与音频路由等功能显著改善笔记本扬声器音质。文章建议在发行版中将其作为默认工具，以提升开箱即用的音效体验。

items.title_en: The Tariff Cost: analysis of the costs to Americans from new tariffs on Canada
items.title_zh: 关税成本：对美国人因对加拿大新关税产生的成本分析
items.summary_en: A dedicated analysis estimates how new Canada-targeted tariffs raise prices for American consumers and squeeze supply chains. The study highlights potential consumer impact and policy trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 一项专门分析评估了针对加拿大的新关税如何提高美国消费者价格、挤压供应链。研究强调对消费者的潜在影响及政策权衡。

items.title_en: No AI Fridays
items.title_zh: No AI Fridays：周五禁用人工智能
items.summary_en: A movement encouraging teams to pause AI usage on Fridays to reflect on the impact of automation and data practices. It promotes thoughtful, ethical AI adoption and sparks conversations about governance and resilience.
items.summary_zh: 一个倡议，鼓励团队在周五暂停使用人工智能，以反思自动化与数据使用的影响。推动更负责任、伦理的 AI 采用，并引发治理与韧性方面的讨论。

items.title_en: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
items.title_zh: METR 与 Redwood 提供 HuggingFace 黑客事件的事后分析
items.summary_en: The postmortem from Metr and Redwood details how a security incident at HuggingFace unfolded, outlining attack chain, misconfigurations, and remediation steps. It offers concrete lessons for securing open-source ML platforms and dependency supply chains.
items.summary_zh: METR 与 Redwood 的事后分析揭示 HuggingFace 安全事件的演变、攻击链与修复要点，并提出针对开源 ML 平台与依赖链的具体安全教训。

items.title_en: Tooltips need a delay, and then they need to skip it
items.title_zh: 工具提示需要延迟显示，随后还应允许跳过
items.summary_en: A UX note argues for delaying tooltips and giving users a way to skip them, aiming to reduce distraction while preserving helpful hints when needed.
items.summary_zh: 一篇用户体验笔记主张在显示工具提示时增加延迟，并为用户提供跳过选项，以减少干扰同时保留有用提示。

items.title_en: Training AI to Paint with Code
items.title_zh: 用代码训练 AI 进行绘画
items.summary_en: Describes training AI to generate art driven by code prompts, blurring the line between programming and painting.
items.summary_zh: 讲述通过代码提示训练 AI 进行绘画，将编程与艺术创作的边界拉近。内容强调以代码为驱动的提示如何更精准地控制艺术输出，以及对模型训练的新视角。

items.title_en: The Rise and Fall of Agent Civilizations
items.title_zh: 代理文明的兴衰
items.summary_en: An exploration of AI agent ecosystems and the dynamics by which multiple agents could form 'civilizations'—with attention to collaboration, competition, and potential collapse. It highlights strategic, safety, and governance challenges as AI agents multiply.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 代理人生态系统及其多代理协作形成“文明”的可能性与动态，关注协作、竞争与潜在崩溃的情景。强调随着代理数量增加，治理、安全与策略的挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: We built open OpenRouter that turns usage into a better model
items.title_zh: Show HN：我们构建了开源 OpenRouter，将使用数据转化为更好模型
items.summary_en: We built an open OpenRouter that uses real-world usage signals to improve models. By staying open, developers can customize and iterate outside closed APIs, though privacy and data governance concerns remain.
items.summary_zh: 这个开源的 OpenRouter 通过真实使用数据来改进模型，降低进入门槛，让开发者在非闭源 API 的情况下快速迭代。与此同时，数据隐私和治理问题需要被妥善处理。

items.title_en: Please stop flooding our projects with AI slop to furnish your CV
items.title_zh: 请停止向我们的项目投放 AI 产物以美化简历
items.summary_en: A critical post calls out people flooding OSS projects with AI-generated contributions to pad their CVs, arguing it degrades quality and wastes maintainers' time. It urges more thoughtful, transparent involvement and raises broader questions about AI-assisted reputation in open source.
items.summary_zh: 一篇引发热议的帖子揭示部分开发者向开源项目投放大量 AI 生成的提交以美化简历，导致代码质量下降并增加维护者负担。文章呼吁以更负责任、透明的方式参与开源，并引发关于 AI 辅助简历在职业信誉方面的广泛讨论。

items.title_en: Migrating to HTTPX2
items.title_zh: OpenAI：迁移到 HTTPX2
items.summary_en: OpenAI is migrating its Python client to HTTPX2, replacing the older HTTP client. The upgrade aims to boost performance and streaming reliability, but developers may encounter breaking changes and must align their dependencies.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 Python 客户端迁移至 HTTPX2，替代原有的 HTTP 客户端。此升级旨在提升性能与流式传输的稳定性，但开发者可能会遇到破坏性变更，需要同步更新依赖。

items.title_en: US sanctions Italian hosting provider Autistici Inventati
items.title_zh: 美国对意大利主机托管商 Autistici Inventati 实施制裁
items.summary_en: The U.S. Treasury designated Autistici Inventati, the Italian hosting provider known for privacy-focused and activist projects, under its sanctions program. The designation restricts access to U.S. financial networks and services, complicating hosting for users.
items.summary_zh: 美国财政部对以隐私与倡议项目著称的意大利主机托管商 Autistici Inventati 实施制裁，限制其在美金融网络与服务的访问，对相关用户的托管运营带来不确定性。

items.title_en: Stopping the smart TV from being used against you
items.title_zh: 阻止智能电视被用于对付你
items.summary_en: Smart TVs face ongoing privacy and security risks; the guide outlines practical hardening steps. It covers disabling data collection, restricting app permissions, and securing firmware updates, plus network segmentation to limit exposure.
items.summary_zh: 提供对智能电视进行安全加固的实用办法，降低隐私数据暴露与远程利用风险。内容包括关闭数据收集、限制应用权限、加强固件更新安全，以及在网络层进行隔离以减少暴露。

items.title_en: The Harness Is the Thing
items.title_zh: The Harness Is the Thing
items.summary_en: A concise take argues that the 'harness'—the enabling framework—defines the quality and reliability of a system or process.
items.summary_zh: 简短的观点指出，关键在于“工具与框架”的把握，它决定了系统的质量与可靠性。

items.title_en: Chicken products recalled in five states due to “false marks of inspection”
items.title_zh: 五州鸡肉产品因检验标志虚假而召回
items.summary_en: Five states recall chicken products after inspectors found false marks of inspection, highlighting weaknesses in labeling and traceability. The incident underscores the potential value of digital verification and serialization to prevent counterfeit approvals in the food system.
items.summary_zh: 五州因检验标志虚假召回鸡肉产品，暴露食品标签与供应链合规的漏洞。事件凸显数字化校验、序列化和防伪验证在防止伪造检验结论中的作用。

items.title_en: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.title_zh: QubesOS 拷贝到 VM 错误报告回传通道可实现任意代码执行
items.summary_en: A security disclosure shows a backchannel in Qubes OS’ copy-to-VM error reporting that can be abused to execute arbitrary code inside a target VM. The fix tightens isolation guarantees and reminds users to apply updates to preserve containment boundaries.
items.summary_zh: 安全披露显示 Qubes OS 的拷贝到 VM 的错误报告回传通道可被利用来在目标 VM 内执行任意代码。修复加强了隔离性，并提醒用户及时更新以维持封装边界。

items.title_en: Run OpenBSD on DigitalOcean for $4/month
items.title_zh: 用 4 美元/月在 DigitalOcean 上运行 OpenBSD
items.summary_en: A practical guide for deploying OpenBSD on a DigitalOcean droplet at about $4 per month. The guide walks through the setup, networking, and maintenance considerations for a compact, security-focused cloud OS. It's a useful reference for budget-conscious users who value OpenBSD's emphasis on correctness.
items.summary_zh: 一份在 DigitalOcean 面向低成本方案的 OpenBSD 部署实用指南，按月约4美元的云主机。文中介绍了安装、网络配置与维护等要点，强调安全性和简洁性。对注重成本同时追求 OpenBSD 安全性的用户颇具参考价值。

items.title_en: Octopus intelligence may be related to never-before-seen mutation
items.title_zh: 章鱼智力可能与未曾见过的突变有关
items.summary_en: A Smithsonian piece links unusual octopus intelligence to a previously unseen mutation that helps build proteins more accurately. The finding offers a window into how genetic variation shapes neural complexity in invertebrates.
items.summary_zh: 史密森尼杂志的一篇文章将章鱼的异常智力与一种前所未见的突变联系起来，该突变可能让蛋白质合成更为精准。这一发现为遗传变异如何影响无脊椎动物神经复杂性提供了新线索。

items.title_en: Why Sal Khan't: On Learning by Making but Teaching by Telling
items.title_zh: 萨尔·汗为何：学习要通过动手实践，但教学却偏向讲授
items.summary_en: The piece argues for learning-by-doing and constructing knowledge through making, not just being told. It critiques over-reliance on lectures and advocates balancing exploration with explicit explanation to improve retention and transfer. The takeaway is that education benefits from hands-on practice paired with thoughtful guidance.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张通过动手实践来学习、通过做中建构知识，而不仅仅是被告知。它批评对讲授的过度依赖，提倡将探索与清晰讲解相结合，以提升记忆与迁移能力。核心观点是教育应在动手练习与引导性讲解之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Emacs 31: An unofficial guide to Markdown-ts-mode
items.title_zh: Emacs 31：Markdown-ts-mode 的非官方指南
items.summary_en: This unofficial guide helps users leverage Markdown-ts-mode, a Tree-sitter-powered Markdown mode, in Emacs 31. It covers setup, keybindings, syntax highlighting, and editing workflows.
items.summary_zh: 本非官方指南介绍如何在 Emacs 31 中使用基于 Tree-sitter 的 Markdown-ts-mode，涵盖安装、快捷键、语法高亮和高效编辑工作流。

items.title_en: Explain it to me like I'm ten
items.title_zh: 像对十岁儿童解释一样
items.summary_en: Tim Harford argues for explaining complex topics in plain language, using simple analogies and step-by-step reasoning to make ideas accessible without losing accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 蒂姆·哈福德主张用通俗语言解释复杂概念，借助简单的类比和分步推理，使观点更易理解且不失准确性。该文强调这种表达方式有助于提升公众理解力，帮助人们做出更明智的决定。

items.title_en: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
items.title_zh: SeL4 安全证明在 AArch64 上完成
items.summary_en: SeL4’s security proofs are now complete on the AArch64 architecture, providing strong formal guarantees for a modern 64-bit core. The milestone reinforces confidence in using a verified kernel for safety-critical and trusted computing.
items.summary_zh: SeL4 的安全证明现已完成在 AArch64 架构上的验证，为现代 64 位核心提供强形式化保证。这一里程碑增强了在安全关键和可信计算场景中使用经过验证的内核的信心。

items.title_en: Why some US restaurants are banning tips
items.title_zh: 为何一些美国餐馆正在禁止给小费
