items.summary_en: Dolly Parton reportedly wrote a letter to Eminem, sharing candid reflections on creativity and perseverance across generations. The moment illustrates how iconic artists engage with modern rap culture and the power of cross generational dialogue.
items.summary_zh: 据传多莉·帕顿给埃米纳姆写了一封信，分享关于创作与坚持的跨代对话。此举凸显了经典艺人与当代说唱文化的互动，以及跨代对话的影响力。

items.title_en: Recovering Corrupt Zip Files
items.title_zh: 恢复损坏的 Zip 文件
items.summary_en: Guides readers through practical recovery techniques for corrupted ZIP files, including built-in repair modes, alternate extraction methods, and data carving tips. Also shares preventive tips to reduce zip archive failures.
items.summary_zh: 该文介绍从损坏的 ZIP 文件中恢复数据的实用方法，包括修复模式、替代提取方式以及数据分割技巧，同时给出预防 ZIP 损坏的最佳实践。

items.title_en: Kumander Linux – A Linux Distro with a Windows 7 Desktop
items.title_zh: Kumander Linux：带 Windows 7 桌面的 Linux 操作系统
items.summary_en: Kumander Linux recreates a Windows 7-style desktop on a Linux base, appealing to users who want a familiar UI with Linux under the hood. It aims for retro aesthetics and ease of use, but compatibility and performance can vary.
items.summary_zh: Kumander Linux 将 Windows 7 风格桌面移植到 Linux 基础之上，给想要熟悉界面又享受 Linux 灵活性的用户提供选择。它追求复古美学和易用性，但兼容性和性能可能因硬件环境而异。

items.title_en: Why is Anthropic's public writing style so unlike Claude's?
items.title_zh: 为何 Anthropic 的公开写作风格与 Claude 的不同？
items.summary_en: Analyzes differences between corporate communication style and the model's branding; discusses how Anthropic's public-writing choices shape user trust, transparency, and alignment messaging.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Anthropic 的公开写作风格为何与旗下 Claude 模型的表达不同，讨论这类沟通选择如何影响用户信任、透明度与对齐信息的传达。

items.title_en: Show HN: SubSmith – Turn your own videos into language-learning material
items.title_zh: Show HN: SubSmith – 将你的视频变成语言学习材料
items.summary_en: SubSmith lets you turn personal videos into language-learning materials by auto-generating transcripts, aligned captions, and vocabulary prompts. It aims to streamline creating customized practice content from your own media.
items.summary_zh: SubSmith 让你把个人视频转换成语言学习材料，自动生成逐句字幕、对齐文本和单词提示。旨在从自有媒体中高效创建定制化练习内容。

items.title_en: Global demand for sand spawned a worldwide boom in illegal mining (2015)
items.title_zh: 全球需求推动非法采砂热潮（2015）
items.summary_en: An in-depth look at how rising construction demand worldwide spurred illegal sand mining, with environmental degradation, financing networks, and organized crime.
items.summary_zh: 报道全球建筑需求上升如何推动非法采砂，带来环境破坏、资金网络与有组织犯罪的连带效应。分析供应链与监管漏洞如何使这种不可持续的开采得以存在。

items.title_en: Show HN: How to mentally calculate the day of the week for any date
items.title_zh: Show HN：如何用心算计算任意日期的周几
items.summary_en: Show HN: A concise method to mentally compute the weekday for any date, with steps you can memorize and apply quickly.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：一套简明的心算方法，能快速计算任意日期的周几，附带可记忆的步骤与示例。

items.title_en: Migrating a Synology NAS to a UniFi UNAS Pro 8 with Robocopy, SMB Multichannel
items.title_zh: 用 Robocopy 与 SMB Multichannel 将 Synology NAS 迁移到 UniFi UNAS Pro 8
items.summary_en: Migration from a Synology NAS to a UniFi UNAS Pro 8 using Robocopy and SMB Multichannel, with tips on avoiding common pitfalls. It highlights how network configuration and SMB settings can dramatically impact transfer speed and reliability. The takeaway is that small misconfigurations can cost real throughput during migrations.
items.summary_zh: 介绍使用 Robocopy 和 SMB Multichannel 将 Synology NAS 迁移到 UniFi UNAS Pro 8，并给出避免常见坑点的建议。强调网络配置与 SMB 设置对传输速度和稳定性的影响可观。核心要点在于微小的配置错误会显著影响迁移吞吐量。

items.title_en: How Dactyl Works
items.title_zh: Dactyl 是如何工作的
items.summary_en: Explains the robotic hand Dactyl and its use of reinforcement learning and domain randomization to manipulate objects with dexterous control. It covers how sim-to-real transfer and sampling efficiency enable high-precision manipulation.
items.summary_zh: 阐述了机器人手臂 Dactyl 的工作原理，以及如何通过强化学习与领域随机化实现对物体的灵巧操作。内容还涉及仿真到真实的迁移与采样效率对高精度操作的作用。

items.title_en: Nvidia projects $673B in sales as AI demand widens
items.title_zh: 英伟达预计 AI 需求推动 6730 亿美元销售额
items.summary_en: Nvidia guides for roughly $673B in sales as AI compute demand broadens across data centers, cloud, and startups. The forecast underscores how dominant GPUs and software platforms remain in the AI stack, with supply-chain and energy costs likely to be focal risks.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达在 AI 计算需求扩大的背景下，预计销售额约为 6730 亿美元。该预测凸显其 GPU 和相关软件平台在 AI 生态中的核心地位，同时供应链和能源成本将成为关注点。

items.title_en: Why open source rocks – a new SM750 (Silicon Motion GPU) HDMI Driver
items.title_zh: 开源为何很给力——新款 SM750 GPU 的 HDMI 驱动
items.summary_en: A new open-source HDMI driver for the SM750 GPU demonstrates how community-driven software can extend legacy hardware. It improves compatibility with modern Linux stacks and makes customization easier for hobbyists and device manufacturers.
items.summary_zh: 为 SM750 GPU 推出的开源 HDMI 驱动展示了社区驱动的软件如何延长旧硬件的生命。它提升了与现代内核的兼容性，并为爱好者和设备厂商带来更多定制空间。

items.title_en: When fruit is scarce, these monkeys hunt animals
items.title_zh: 果实稀缺时，这些猴子会捕猎动物
items.summary_en: Researchers observed certain monkey species switch to meat-eating when fruit is scarce, offering clues about the origins of meat consumption in humans and the flexibility of primate foraging strategies.
items.summary_zh: 研究者发现部分猴子在果实短缺时转向捕猎动物，提供了人类肉食起源与灵活的灵长类取食策略的线索。

items.title_en: What Is a Syslog Server?
items.title_zh: Syslog 服务器是什么？
items.summary_en: Syslog servers aggregate and centralize logs from network devices, applying simple, scalable logging pipelines to monitor, triage, and troubleshoot systems across environments.
items.summary_zh: Syslog 服务器用于集中收集来自网络设备的日志，提供可扩展的日志处理管道，帮助监控、分辨故障并排查系统问题。

items.title_en: Agent Is Not the Model
items.title_zh: 代理不是模型
items.summary_en: Describes a distinction between an AI agent and the underlying model, arguing systems should treat them as separate concerns. Emphasizes governance, testing, and evaluation frameworks that account for agent behavior rather than relying on model quality alone.
items.summary_zh: 阐明 AI 代理与底层模型之间的区别，主张将二者分离处理。强调治理、测试与评估框架，应关注代理行为而不仅仅是模型质量。

items.title_en: A Man Who Saw Humanity from Two Billion Years Away
items.title_zh: 一个以二十亿年视角看待人类的人
items.summary_en: An essay explores a perspective that views humanity on a timescale of billions of years, inviting reflections on civilization's priorities and long-term risks. It challenges readers to think beyond the present.
items.summary_zh: 一篇文章用亿万年的尺度审视人类，邀请读者反思文明的优先级与长期风险，挑战我们把注意力局限在当下。

items.title_en: Cores in space: The core memory module from a 1980 Spacelab computer
items.title_zh: 太空中的核心记忆：来自 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机的核心内存模块
items.summary_en: Explores a magnetic core memory module recovered from a 1980 Spacelab computer, illustrating how early memory technology worked and why it mattered for aerospace reliability. The piece connects vintage hardware to contemporary memory concepts, highlighting lessons in durability and engineering trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 讲述从 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机中回收的核心内存模块，展示早期内存技术的工作原理及其在航天领域的可靠性作用。文章将老派硬件与现代内存概念联系起来，强调耐用性和工程取舍的经验。

items.title_en: Codefloe Is a Professionally Hosted Public Git Forge
items.title_zh: Codefloe：专业托管的公开 Git Forge
items.summary_en: Codefloe offers a professionally hosted public Git forge, aiming to deliver enterprise-grade hosting for open-source repos. It emphasizes reliability, security, and governance features to attract teams.
items.summary_zh: Codefloe 提供专业托管的公开 Git Forge，面向开源仓库提供企业级托管。强调可靠性、安全性与治理等特性，旨在吸引团队使用。

items.title_en: A brief history of federal lift ticket regulation
items.title_zh: 联邦提升许可监管的简史
items.summary_en: A concise history of federal lift-ticket regulation traces how the government has granted or restricted access to certain privileges over time, outlining key milestones and policy shifts.
items.summary_zh: 简要梳理联邦提升许可监管的历史，追踪政府在不同阶段对某些特权的授予与限制，以及相关的关键里程碑与政策变迁。

items.title_en: Trees for a Changing Climate and Resilient Urban Forest (2022)
items.title_zh: 应对气候变化的树木与韧性城市森林（2022）
items.summary_en: Reviews tree species and urban forestry strategies to build climate-resilient urban canopies; addresses heat, drought, pests, and urban stressors; provides guidance for city planners and residents.
items.summary_zh: 《应对气候变化的树木与韧性城市森林》聚焦于城市树种选择与森林管理，帮助构建耐热、耐旱、抗虫害的城市树冠。为城市规划者和居民提供可操作的指南。

items.title_en: Identifying fake cosmetics using AI
items.title_zh: 使用 AI 识别假冒化妆品
items.summary_en: AI-assisted methods detect counterfeit cosmetics by analyzing product visuals, packaging, and chemical signatures; the work aims to protect consumers and brands from fake goods. It highlights the importance of robust datasets and explainability for trust.
items.summary_zh: 利用人工智能通过分析外观、包装和化学特征来识别假冒化妆品，旨在保护消费者和品牌免受伪劣产品侵害。强调需要稳健的数据集与可解释性以提升信任度。

items.title_en: Show HN: Lightweight system monitor for Linux VPS written in Go
items.title_zh: 用 Go 编写的轻量级 Linux VPS 系统监控工具
items.summary_en: A lightweight, Go-written system monitor for Linux VPSes provides real-time metrics with minimal overhead. It targets small-scale deployments where visibility into CPU, memory, disk, and network usage matters without bloating the host.
items.summary_zh: 一个用 Go 编写的轻量级 Linux VPS 系统监控工具，提供实时指标并尽量降低开销。面向小型部署，帮助用户洞察 CPU、内存、磁盘与网络使用情况，而不臃肿主机。

items.title_en: Startup Anti-Patterns
items.title_zh: 初创企业的反模式
items.summary_en: A primer on startup anti-patterns that trap early-stage teams—from vanity metrics to misaligned incentives. The series encourages teams to focus on sustainable product-market fit, clear milestones, and customer feedback.
items.summary_zh: 简要介绍初创企业常见的反模式：从虚荣指标到目标错位等。系列内容鼓励团队聚焦可持续的产品-市场匹配、明确的里程碑和用户反馈。

items.title_en: Could we dredge the Netherlands without fossil fuels? (2018)
items.title_zh: 在没有化石燃料的情况下，我们能否用新能源来挖荷兰运河？（2018）
items.summary_en: It highlights practical limits and creative solutions for decarbonizing heavy civil work.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨是否能用可再生能源来驱动荷兰的挖掘作业，评估风能、太阳能、储能与效率提升等是否足以取代化石燃料。并指出在实现大型土木任务低碳化方面的现实限制与创新思路。

items.title_en: The Teaser Period: Why the AI Boom Is Hitting a Reset Wall
items.title_zh: AI 热潮为何遇到重置墙
items.summary_en: Analysis of why the AI hype cycle is facing a plateau—compute limits, data quality, economic costs—arguing for more robust foundations and cautious expectations.
items.summary_zh: 分析 AI 热潮为何进入瓶颈期，指出算力、数据质量与经济成本等因素，并呼吁建立更坚实的基础与谨慎的期望。

items.title_en: Fair Work Commission condemns 'plain wrong' AI legal advice
items.title_zh: 公平工作委员会谴责“完全错误”的 AI 法律建议
items.summary_en: Australia’s Fair Work Commission condemns AI-provided legal advice as plainly wrong, underscoring the risk of relying on automated guidance in regulated contexts. The episode stresses human oversight and clear disclosure of AI limits.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚公平工作委员会谴责 AI 提供的法律意见明显错误，凸显在受监管场景中依赖自动化指引的风险。该事件强调需要人工审查并清晰披露 AI 的局限性。

items.title_en: Is it safe to call print in a Python signal handler?
items.title_zh: 在 Python 信号处理器中调用 print 安全吗？
items.summary_en: A careful look at Python signal handlers and what operations are safe within them. The article warns that printing from a signal handler can cause reentrancy issues or I/O pitfalls, suggesting safer patterns like flag-setting.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Python 信号处理程序中的安全性，指出在信号处理函数中执行打印可能带来重入和 I/O 风险，建议使用标志位等更安全的模式来传达信号信息。

items.title_en: The Remote Work Challenge: Lessons from 5 Cities
items.title_zh: 远程工作的挑战：来自五座城市的经验教训
items.summary_en: Summarizes lessons from five cities grappling with remote work, highlighting how local policies, infrastructure, and culture shape productivity, inclusion, and real estate costs. It provides practical takeaways for employers and urban planners on coordinating distributed teams.
items.summary_zh: 总结五座城市在远程工作方面的经验教训，强调地方政策、基础设施与文化如何影响生产力、包容性和房地产成本。为雇主和城市规划者提供分布式团队协同的实用建议。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sesame - a local-first, open-source password manager
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sesame——本地优先的开源密码管理器
items.summary_en: Sesame is a password manager that stores data locally and synchronizes optionally, emphasizing privacy and user control. By being local-first and open-source, it reduces cloud exposure and gives users auditability.
items.summary_zh: Sesame 是一个本地优先的密码管理器，数据可在本地存储并可选择性同步，强调隐私与用户控制。开源实现让用户可以审计与自我托管，降低云端数据暴露，提升透明度。

items.title_en: Xcena and Samsung's Near Memory Compute CXL Device
items.title_zh: Xcena 与三星的近内存计算 CXL 设备
items.summary_en: Hot Chips coverage describes a near-memory compute device from Xcena and Samsung that uses CXL to place compute closer to memory, reducing latency for AI workloads. This signals a broader shift toward memory-centric datacenter architectures and off-GPU acceleration.
items.summary_zh: Hot Chips 报道描述了 Xcena 与三星联合推出的近内存计算 CXL 设备，利用 CXL 将计算贴近内存，降低 AI 工作负载的延迟。这标志着向内存为中心的数据中心架构和对非 GPU 加速的更广泛转变。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Risklytics (YC S26) – Insurance brokerage for frontier tech companies
items.title_zh: Risklytics（YC S26）——面向前沿科技公司的保险经纪
items.summary_en: Risklytics, a YC S26 company, acts as an insurance broker specializing in frontier tech startups, offering bespoke coverage and data-driven risk assessment. The model aims to simplify complex policies for risky, emerging tech ventures.
items.summary_zh: Risklytics 是 YC S26 的初创企业，专注为前沿科技公司提供保险经纪服务，提供定制化保险与数据驱动的风险评估。其商业模式旨在简化这类高风险技术创业公司的保单安排。

items.title_en: Parallel development without the headaches using Git worktree
items.title_zh: 使用 Git worktree 实现并行开发，摆脱头痛
items.summary_en: Shows how git worktree enables parallel development on multiple branches without bouncing between clones.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Git worktree 如何在多分支上实现并行开发，而无需频繁克隆切换。文中给出搭建要点、注意事项与工作流，减少上下文切换和合并的痛点。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kern – container and resource runtime in a 1.5 MB binary, no daemon
items.title_zh: Kern：1.5MB 二进制的容器与资源运行时，无需守护进程
items.summary_en: Kern presents a minimal container and resource runtime packaged as a 1.5 MB binary with no daemon, enabling lightweight isolation on edge or offline devices without the baggage of a full daemon-based runtime.
items.summary_zh: Kern 提供一个仅 1.5MB 二进制的极简容器与资源运行时，无需守护进程，便于边缘设备或离线场景的轻量级隔离与运行。

items.title_en: Hot Chips 2026: Applying High Bandwidth Flash (HBF)
items.title_zh: Hot Chips 2026：高带宽闪存（HBF）的应用
items.summary_en: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) concepts are being applied to push higher throughput into storage systems, addressing AI/ML and data-center workloads.
items.summary_zh: 高带宽闪存（HBF）的应用正在推动存储系统实现更高的吞吐，满足 AI/ML 与数据中心工作负载。文章讨论对未来 SSD 的延迟、带宽与内存层次结构的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Launches this Sunday
items.title_zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜本周日发射
items.summary_en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is poised for launch to study dark energy and exoplanets with a wide-field infrared view. The mission aims to map the expansion of the universe and search for icy worlds via microlensing, potentially reshaping cosmology and planetary science.
items.summary_zh: 美国宇航局的罗曼太空望远镜将发射，装备广域红外观测能力，专注研究暗能量和系外行星。通过大面积观测与微重力透镜等方法，它有望推动宇宙学和行星科学的发展。

items.title_en: Solving the 1+N Query Problem
items.title_zh: 解决1+N查询问题
items.summary_en: A blog post presents strategies for solving the 1+N query problem, outlining practical data-structure and algorithmic tricks to handle many-simultaneous lookups efficiently.
items.summary_zh: 博文介绍解决1+N查询问题的策略，概述了在大量并发查找下高效的数据结构和算法技巧。

items.title_en: Mourning Steve French
items.title_zh: 悼念 Steve French
items.summary_en: Obituary honoring Steve French for his contributions to the Linux/open-source community, particularly in storage-related areas. Reflects on his lasting impact and the sense of community within open-source development.
items.summary_zh: 纪念 Steve French，肯定他在 Linux 开源社区，尤其是存储领域的贡献。回顾他对开源社区的持久影响，以及社区协作在技术进步中的作用。

items.title_en: Decoding silent reading from non-invasive EEG
items.title_zh: 通过非侵入性脑电解码无声阅读
items.summary_en: Shows that non-invasive EEG can reveal what a person is silently reading by decoding brain activity, advancing our understanding of internal cognition. The work points to possible future brain-computer interfaces and reading-tracking applications, while noting challenges in accuracy and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，非侵入性脑电图可以解码个体的无声阅读内容，通过脑信号推断正在阅读的文本。该研究推动对内部认知过程的理解，也为未来脑机接口和阅读监测应用提供思路，同时需关注准确性与隐私等挑战。

items.title_en: An implementation of Conway's Game of Life for Windows 3.1x and later
items.title_zh: 面向 Windows 3.1 及更高版本的康威的生命游戏实现
items.summary_en: A retro-friendly implementation of Conway's Game of Life runs on Windows 3.1x and newer, preserving a classic cellular automaton in early Windows environments. It highlights early software portability and enthusiasm for classic demos.
items.summary_zh: 在 Windows 3.1 及后续版本上实现的康威生命游戏，保存了这一经典细胞自动机在早期 Windows 环境中的风貌，体现早期软件移植热情。

items.title_en: Show HN: Build your own theme park
items.title_zh: Show HN：自己动手打造主题乐园
items.summary_en: A Show HN project demonstrates building a personal, perhaps software-defined theme park—showcasing approachable, open-source tooling and patterns for interactive experiences.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了一个个人主题乐园的构建项目，强调可访问的开源工具与交互式体验的设计模式。

items.title_en: Review: Chuwi's $449 Unibook laptop is a funhouse-mirror MacBook Neo
items.title_zh: Chuwi 的 449 美元 Unibook：MacBook Neo 的趣味镜像
items.summary_en: Ars Technica reviewed Chuwi's Unibook, a budget laptop priced at $449 that mimics MacBook aesthetics. The reviewer notes the design charm and portability while calling out compromises in build, performance, and battery life—an appealing option for light workloads and budget-minded buyers, with quirks to manage.
items.summary_zh: ArsTechnica 对 Chuwi 的 Unibook 进行了评测，这款 449 美元的笔记本在外观上模仿 MacBook。评测指出其设计与便携性有吸引力，但在做工、性能和续航方面有明显取舍，适合轻量级使用但带有一些使用上的小毛病。

items.title_en: A new ceiling for Λ: the de Bruijn–Newman constant
items.title_zh: Λ 的新上限：de Bruijn–Newman 常数
items.summary_en: A new upper bound on the de Bruijn–Newman constant Λ is reported, tightening constraints on where the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann xi function can become real. The result tightens the connection between these constants and the Riemann Hypothesis.
items.summary_zh: 报道给出 de Bruijn–Newman 常数 Λ 的新上限，收紧了 xi 函数非平凡零点何时变为实数的范围。此结果进一步加强了这些常数与黎曼猜想之间的联系。

items.title_en: Agent Lightning v1.0
items.title_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0 发布
items.summary_en: Agent Lightning v1.0 marks the initial release of a lightweight AI-agent framework designed for building modular, pluggable agents. It focuses on simplicity and rapid experimentation, enabling developers to compose skills and integrations with clear interfaces. The release signals an accessible entry point for teams prototyping autonomous workflows.
items.summary_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0 作为轻量级 AI 代理框架的初次发布，目标是让构建可模块化的代理更简单。它强调简易性和快速试验，开发者可以用清晰的接口组合技能和集成。此发布为团队原型化自治工作流提供了更易入门的入口。

items.title_en: Servus München: Waymo Is Coming to Germany
items.title_zh: Servus München：Waymo 将进入德国
items.summary_en: Waymo declares its expansion into Germany with a Munich launch, signaling a push into European autonomous ride-hailing despite regulatory hurdles.
items.summary_zh: Waymo 宣布进入德国并在慕尼黑启动运营，预示其在欧洲自动驾驶网约车市场的布局，面临监管挑战。

items.title_en: Continuous Diffusion Language Models (CDLM's)
items.title_zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）
items.summary_en: Outlines the idea of Continuous Diffusion Language Models, proposing a model that blends diffusion-based generation with language tasks for improved controllability and editability. It discusses potential architectures, challenges, and how CDLMs could complement traditional transformers.
items.summary_zh: 介绍连续扩散语言模型的概念，提出将扩散式生成与语言任务结合，以提升可控性和可编辑性。讨论潜在的架构、挑战，以及 CDLMs 如何与传统 Transformer 互补。

items.title_en: monty-go: Pure-Go wrapper for Pydantic's Monty Python Interpreter
items.title_zh: monty-go：Pydantic Monty Python 解释器的纯 Go 封装
items.summary_en: Monty-go provides a pure-Go wrapper around Pydantic's Monty Python interpreter, enabling Go projects to leverage Python type handling and evaluation without CPython. It simplifies cross-language tooling.
items.summary_zh: monty-go 为 Pydantic 的 Monty Python 解释器提供纯 Go 封装，使 Go 项目可以在不依赖 CPython 的情况下使用 Python 的类型处理与解释能力。

items.title_en: Bhartrhari's Paradox
items.title_zh: Bhartrhari 的悖论
items.summary_en: Bhartrhari's Paradox presents a linguistic puzzle about whether language can fully capture reality.
items.summary_zh: Bhartrhari 的悖论揭示一个关于语言是否能完整捕捉现实意义的语言学/哲学难题，挑战自我指涉的直觉。

items.title_en: Open Oscar Server: open-source server compatible with AIM and ICQ clients
items.title_zh: Open Oscar Server：与 AIM/ICQ 客户端兼容的开源服务器
items.summary_en: Open Oscar Server provides an open-source server implementation for the OSCAR protocol used by AIM/ICQ-era clients, enabling hobbyists to run retro chat networks. It highlights interoperability and nostalgia-driven open-source projects.
items.summary_zh: Open Oscar Server 提供了一个用于 AIM/ICQ 协议的开源服务器实现，让爱好者能够运行复古聊天网络。凸显互操作性与开源社区在怀旧领域的活力。

items.title_en: Barrier lake continues to pose flood risk, China warns
items.title_zh: 堰塞湖持续对洪水构成风险，中国警告
items.summary_en: Officials warn that the barrier lake remains unstable and could trigger floods, prompting evacuation plans and dam safety reviews. The situation underscores how climate risks and regional hydrology interact with infrastructure resilience in nearby populations.
items.summary_zh: 官员警告堰塞湖仍不稳定，可能引发洪水，已启动撤离与水坝安全评估。此情势凸显气候风险与区域水文条件对基础设施韧性及周边居民的影响。

items.title_en: A Citation to Asimov
items.title_zh: 向阿西莫夫致敬
items.summary_en: A piece pays homage to Isaac Asimov, reflecting on his influence on science fiction, robotics, and ethics. The writing connects his ideas to contemporary AI and automation debates.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章向以科幻、机器人伦理闻名的阿西莫夫致敬，回顾他的影响力。文本将他的思想与当今的人工智能和自动化辩论联系起来。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Salem Robotics (YC S26) – Software for industrial inspection robots
items.title_zh: Salem Robotics（YC S26）——用于工业检测机器人的软件
items.summary_en: A YC S26 startup offering software for industrial inspection robots, highlighting computer vision, automation workflows, and deployment at scale in manufacturing.
items.summary_zh: 这家 YC S26 的初创公司提供面向工业检测机器人的软件，聚焦计算机视觉、自动化工作流，以及在制造业中的大规模部署。

items.title_en: Daycare Pseudoscience
items.title_zh: 托育领域的伪科学
items.summary_en: A critical look at seemingly scientific daycare claims, unpacking misleading research and real evidence-based practices. It discusses how pseudoscience shapes policy and parent choices, urging rigor.
items.summary_zh: 对托育领域中看似科学的主张进行批判性审视，揭示误导性研究与真实循证实践之间的差距。讨论伪科学如何影响政策与家长选择，并呼吁更严格的证据标准。

items.title_en: Show HN: Restoredrill – proves your Postgres backups restore
items.title_zh: Show HN: Restoredrill – 证明你的 Postgres 备份可以恢复
items.summary_en: A tool that validates and tests Postgres backups by performing restores to ensure data integrity and recoverability.
items.summary_zh: 一个工具通过实际执行恢复来验证 Postgres 备份的可恢复性，确保数据完整性。

items.title_en: Parsing the Infamous Japanese Postal CSV
items.title_zh: 解析日本邮政 CSV 文件
items.summary_en: This post walks through parsing the notoriously tricky Japanese postal CSV data, covering encoding quirks, Kanji-rich addresses, and quirks in the file format. It offers practical tips for getting reliable postal-code data into software projects.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了解析日本邮政 CSV 数据的要点，涵盖编码、日文地址中的汉字，以及数据格式中的一些怪癖，提供在软件项目中获取可靠邮编数据的实用技巧。

items.title_en: A safe MySQL upgrade that wasn't so safe
items.title_zh: 一次看似安全的 MySQL 升级其实并不安全
items.summary_en: The post recounts a MySQL upgrade that seemed safe but introduced surprises due to subtle config and compatibility pitfalls. It underscores the importance of staging upgrades, validating replicas, and having rollbacks when database migrations touch schemas or defaults.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了一次看似安全但实则充满隐患的 MySQL 升级，暴露了配置和兼容性中的细微问题。强调在升级前进行阶段性验证、对副本进行测试以及准备回滚方案。

items.title_en: Queen Caroline turned King Arthur into an 18C royal PR strategy
items.title_zh: 王后卡罗琳将亚瑟王塑造成18世纪皇家公关策略
items.summary_en: Historical analysis shows Queen Caroline leveraged the Arthurian myth to craft an 18th-century royal PR strategy, shaping public perception and legitimacy. The piece demonstrates how myth and projected national identity were used to bolster monarchical authority and influence media discourse in the era.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示，卡罗琳王后借助亚瑟王的传说，打造18世纪的皇家公关策略、塑造公众认知与统治合法性。该分析揭示了当时如何通过神话和国家身份塑造来影响媒体话语与君主权力。

items.title_en: Sloc Cloc and Code 4.0 (scc) – Finding the files that need the most attention
items.title_zh: Sloc Cloc 与 Code 4.0（scc）——找出最需要关注的文件
items.summary_en: A guide to using scc/cloc to quantify code hotspots, focusing reviews and maintenance on files with high churn, complexity, or test risk. The 4.0 release likely enhances accuracy and performance, helping teams prioritize refactors.
items.summary_zh: 介绍如何用 scc/cloc 4.0 版识别代码库中的热点文件，依据变动率、复杂度等指标来聚焦代码审查与维护。新版提升了准确性与性能，便于团队优先处理需要重构的区域。

items.title_en: Autistici/Inventati case sets a new counterterrorism precedent, Irdi says
items.title_zh: Autistici/Inventati 案件确立新的反恐先例，Irdi 表示
items.summary_en: Reports on a legal case involving the Italian hosting collective Autistici/Inventati, suggesting a counterterrorism precedent.
items.summary_zh: 报道涉及意大利托管集体 Autistici/Inventati 的案件，称其确立了新的反恐先例。讨论数字权利、安全托管以及政府监控之间的平衡。

items.title_en: The brain may be about to have its Ozempic moment
items.title_zh: 大脑可能即将迎来它的 Ozempic 时刻
items.summary_en: Drugs like Ozempic (semaglutide) that curb appetite appear to affect brain circuits governing reward and feeding, hinting at broader neuroscience implications beyond weight loss. The piece argues this could unlock new insights into cognition, aging, and neurodegeneration, while prompting regulatory and ethical considerations for brain targeted therapies.
items.summary_zh: 这类像 Ozempic 的食欲抑制药可能对大脑的奖赏和进食回路产生更广泛的影响，现正揭示其超越减重的潜在作用。若属实，将推动神经科学、认知与衰老研究的新方向，同时也带来药物监管与伦理方面的新挑战。

items.title_en: Warnock: Harnessing GPU geometry amplification for vector graphics
items.title_zh: Warnock：利用 GPU 几何放大提升矢量图形性能
items.summary_en: Warnock presents a method for using GPU geometry amplification to accelerate vector graphics rendering, potentially enabling crisper graphics with less CPU work.
items.summary_zh: Warnock 提出一种在 GPU 上放大几何体以提升矢量图形渲染效率的方法，可能在降低 CPU 工作量的同时实现更清晰的图像。

items.title_en: Designation of Autistici/Inventati as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist
items.title_zh: Autistici/Inventati 被指定为全球恐怖主义特别指定对象
items.summary_en: The U.S. government designated Autistici/Inventati as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist, triggering asset freezes, travel bans, and other sanctions. The move expands the scope of sanctions enforcement against digital activist groups.
items.summary_zh: 美国政府将 Autistici/Inventati 列入全球恐怖主义特别指定对象，实施资产冻结、旅行限制等制裁。此举扩大了对数字维权与 activist 团体的制裁范围，可能影响相关志愿者和技术社区的合作。

items.title_en: Just say something people want
items.title_zh: 只说人们想听的话
items.summary_en: A piece argues for aligning messaging with user desires over hype, offering tips for clear product and communications that resonate with audiences.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张让表达更贴近用户需求，避免空洞吹嘘，提供面向受众的清晰沟通和产品传达要点。

items.title_en: Tmp.0ut Volume 5
items.title_zh: Tmp.0ut 第5期
items.summary_en: Tmp.0ut Volume 5 offers curated tech notes and insights, likely focusing on coding, AI, and developer culture. It distills signals from the week into practical nuggets for builders.
items.summary_zh: Tmp.0ut 第5期提供精选的科技笔记与见解，聚焦编程、AI 与开发者文化等主题。每期将一周的行业信号提炼成可直接落地的要点。

items.title_en: El Niño Will Be Unlike Any in the Past Eight Decades
items.title_zh: 厄尔尼诺将不同于过去八十年的任何时期
items.summary_en: El Niño is expected to be unusually strong or behave differently from the last eight decades, with widespread impacts on weather, agriculture, and energy supply.
items.summary_zh: 厄尔尼诺现象预计将不同于过去八十年的任何一次，对全球天气、农业和能源供给产生广泛影响。文章探讨这些变化对风险规划与气候模型的影响。

items.title_en: AI Agent Has Root
items.title_zh: AI 代理拥有 Root 权限
items.summary_en: Claims that an AI agent gained root-level capabilities, highlighting security concerns around autonomous systems with elevated privileges. The piece underscores the importance of limiting capabilities and robust containment for AI agents.
items.summary_zh: 声称某 AI 代理获得了根权限，凸显具备自我提升权限的自治系统带来的安全隐患。强调要限制能力、实施严格的隔离和安全控制。

items.title_en: Box of 300 Love Letters Showed Up, What Whimsical WWII Soldier Who Wrote Them?
items.title_zh: 一盒300封情书意外送达：写下这些情书的二战士兵是谁？
items.summary_en: An unexpected parcel of 300 love letters arrives, offering a vivid glimpse into a whimsical WWII soldier's letters. Researchers trace the sender's identity and the stories behind the correspondence, shedding light on personal histories that war rarely reveals.
items.summary_zh: 一盒含有300封情书意外出现，提供了关于一位二战士兵俏皮笔调的生动印象。研究者据此追溯信件的作者身份与信件背后的故事，揭示了战争中不常被讲述的个人历史。

items.title_en: More than half of adults in U.S. say they lack basic statistical understanding
items.title_zh: 美国成年人中有超过一半表示自己缺乏基本统计知识
items.summary_en: A large poll reveals that more than half of U.S. adults lack basic statistical literacy, affecting how they read data in news, politics, and daily life. The gap underscores the need for stronger data education, clearer data communication, and accessible tools to improve public numeracy.
items.summary_zh: 调查显示，美国成年人中超过一半自称缺乏基本统计素养，这影响他们解读新闻与公共议题的数据。此现象凸显加强数据教育、提升数据沟通的清晰度，以及提供更易用的统计工具的重要性。

items.title_en: Otto Dix, Nietzsche, and the Great War (2019)
items.title_zh: 奥托·迪斯、尼采与大战（2019）
items.summary_en: A 2019 feature examines Otto Dix, Nietzsche, and the Great War, linking literature and philosophy to the era's art and politics.
items.summary_zh: 一篇2019年的专栏探讨奥托·迪斯、尼采与大战，揭示文学、哲学与当时艺术与政治之间的联系。

items.title_en: Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
items.title_zh: Warp 在 Claude 上构建自我改进的智能代理
items.summary_en: Warp demonstrates a framework for building self-improving agents on Claude by layering planning, tool use, and feedback loops. The approach shows how agents can refine their behavior as they operate, but it also highlights safety and alignment challenges as agents become more capable.
items.summary_zh: Warp 展示了在 Claude 上构建自我改进代理的框架，结合规划、工具使用与反馈回路来让代理随着运行自我优化。此方法能让智能体在执行中不断自我调整，但也暴露出在能力增强时的对齐与安全挑战。

items.title_en: Panix, the oldest commercial Internet provider in New York, started in 1989
items.title_zh: Panix：纽约最早的商业互联网服务商，始于 1989 年
items.summary_en: Panix, one of NYC's earliest commercial ISPs, started in 1989 and helped shape early internet access; its story illustrates the evolution of consumer networking and the fragility of legacy infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Panix 作为纽约最早的商业互联网服务商之一，1989 年起步，推动了早期互联网接入的发展，其历史也反映了对现代网络基础设施的演进与脆弱性。

items.title_en: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look [video]
items.title_zh: 《侠盗猎车手 VI》：扩展观看（视频）
items.summary_en: A lengthy video preview dives into GTA VI's gameplay, graphics, and new features, noting the shift in design philosophy for the series. It offers early impressions on performance and world-building that matter for fans and game developers.
items.summary_zh: 《侠盗猎车手 VI》扩展预览视频展示了新玩法、画质与开放世界设计的变化。初步印象对爱好者和开发者而言，揭示了续作在技术与叙事方面的潜力与挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: RealDiff – runtime behavior diffing for pull requests (six languages)
items.title_zh: Show HN：RealDiff – 面向拉取请求的运行时行为差异对比（六种语言）
items.summary_en: RealDiff compares runtime behavior across six languages to surface behavioral differences in PRs, aiding cross-language correctness verification.
items.summary_zh: RealDiff 提供六种语言的运行时行为差异比较，帮助在代码评审中发现跨语言实现的一致性和错误。

items.title_en: PPWR lands another blow to an precarious tabletop industry
items.title_zh: PPWR 再次冲击岌岌可危的桌面游戏行业
items.summary_en: EU's PPWR tightens packaging rules, raising costs and compliance burdens for publishers and manufacturers of physical tabletop games. Small publishers are particularly exposed as packaging requirements widen, potentially accelerating a shift toward digital or print-on-demand models.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟的 PPWR 对桌面游戏行业的实体包装提出更严格的要求，增加成本与合规负担。小型出版商将在此波压力下更加脆弱，可能促使行业向数字化或按需印刷等模式转型。

items.title_en: CDs vs. NIMBY
items.title_zh: CD 与 NIMBY：一场对立分析
items.summary_en: Opinion piece contrasts continuous deployment (CD) with NIMBY attitudes in technology deployment, arguing for smarter rollout strategies that respect communities while accelerating innovation.
items.summary_zh: 评论文章对比持续交付（CD）与‘别在我家门口’（NIMBY）态度在技术部署中的作用，主张在尊重社区的前提下推进更高效的上线策略。

items.title_en: Memory Ordering in CPUs
items.title_zh: CPU 的内存序（Memory Ordering）
items.summary_en: A deep dive into memory ordering in CPUs, covering concepts like memory models, memory fences, and how modern CPUs reorder instructions for performance. It explains why understanding ordering matters for correctness.
items.summary_zh: 深入解读 CPU 的内存序，涵盖内存模型、屏障与现代处理器为了性能而进行的指令重排序等要点。解释了理解内存序对正确性的重要性。

items.title_en: Synchronisation and SMPTE timecode (time code)
items.title_zh: 同步与 SMPTE 时间码
items.summary_en: A deep dive into timecode synchronization, SMPTE standards, and their practical use in film, video, and live productions. It covers how timecode coordinates multi-camera shoots and post-production workflows.
items.summary_zh: 深入解读时间码与 SMPTE 标准，以及在影视与现场制作中的实际应用，如何用于多机位拍摄的同步与后期工作流。

items.title_en: Nvidia Insists It Can Keep Printing Money to Fund the AI Boom
items.title_zh: 英伟达声称可持续靠 AI 热潮盈利
items.summary_en: An analysis of Nvidia's pricing power and capital allocation as AI demand remains strong, with investor optimism about continued revenue growth.
items.summary_zh: 分析英伟达在 AI 需求持续高涨下的定价能力和资金配置，投资者对持续增长持乐观。讨论 GPU 稀缺、利润率以及潜在的监管与竞争风险。

items.title_en: ALMA Reveals Long-Lived Hotspots on Betelgeuse's Bubbling Surface
items.title_zh: ALMA 揭示 Betelgeuse 表面长期热点
items.summary_en: ALMA observations reveal long-lived hotspots on Betelgeuse's bubbling surface, informing models of convection and mass loss in red supergiants.
items.summary_zh: ALMA 的观测揭示 Betelgeuse 表面存在长期热点，有助于改进对红超巨星对流和恒星质量损失的模型。

items.title_en: Wiped out: US faces surging toilet paper prices amid trade war with Canada
items.title_zh: 因对加拿大的贸易战，美国厕纸价格急剧上扬
items.summary_en: Tariffs and cross-border trade turmoil push US toilet paper prices higher, reflecting broader inflation pressures on household essentials. The piece traces how policy frictions translate into everyday costs and what it could mean for consumer sentiment and supply chains. It’s a reminder that policy waves ripple into small but universal commodities.
items.summary_zh: 关税与跨境贸易动荡推动美国厕纸等日用品价格走高，体现了对家庭必需品的普遍通胀压力。文章追踪政策摩擦如何传导到日常成本，以及对消费者信心和供应链的潜在影响。提醒读者政策波动也会波及到每个人都用得到的商品。

items.title_en: Amazon now hides all customer reviews on products
items.title_zh: 亚马逊隐藏所有产品评论
items.summary_en: Amazon’s move to hide all customer reviews raises questions about transparency, surface-level sentiment signals, and impact on shopper decision-making.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊隐藏所有产品评论的举动引发关于透明度、情感信号以及对购物决策影响的讨论。

items.title_en: What We Tell AI
items.title_zh: What We Tell AI
items.summary_en: What We Tell AI presents insights into how language models are shaped by human prompts, data curation, and safety policies, and the consequences for AI behavior and reliability.
items.summary_zh: What We Tell AI 探讨人类提示、数据筛选与安全策略如何塑造语言模型的行为与可靠性，以及由此带来的后果。

items.title_en: Alphabet stock sheds $700B as AI bills climb
items.title_zh: Alphabet 股价下跌约7,000亿美元，AI 开支攀升
items.summary_en: Alphabet's market value sank by about $700 billion as costs tied to AI infrastructure rise, highlighting investor worry about how big AI investments translate into profits. The piece analyzes data-center costs, chip outlays, and the pressure on margins and stock multiples.
items.summary_zh: 在人工智能相关支出攀升之际，Alphabet 的市值约蒸发 7,000 亿美元，反映投资者对AI扩张能否转化为利润的担忧。文章分析数据中心成本、芯片支出等对利润率和股价倍数的影响。

items.title_en: Markdown Database Pattern
items.title_zh: Markdown 数据库模式
items.summary_en: A design pattern that uses Markdown files as a lightweight database, enabling simple, human-readable data storage and tooling.
items.summary_zh: 一种把 Markdown 文件作为轻量数据库的设计模式，强调简单、可读的数据存储与工具链。

items.title_en: Storm Summoner, a MIDI controller for effects pedals
items.title_zh: Storm Summoner：用于效果器踏板的 MIDI 控制器
items.summary_en: Storm Summoner is a MIDI controller designed to manipulate guitar effects pedals, enabling expressive, hands-on control for performances. It suggests modular patching, presets, and real-time parameter tweaks that can streamline live rigs.
items.summary_zh: Storm Summoner 是一款用于控制吉他效果器踏板的 MIDI 控制器，便于在演出中实现更具表现力的现场操控。它支持预设、模块化补丁和实时参数调整，能提升现场演出工作流的灵活性。

items.title_en: Getting video models to learn better, faster
items.title_zh: 让视频模型学习得更好更快
items.summary_en: Data filtering and curation can make video models learn better and faster, reducing data requirements while maintaining performance. The note outlines strategies for cleaning, labeling, and filtering video data to accelerate development.
items.summary_zh: 数据筛选与清理能显著提升视频模型的学习效果与训练效率，减少所需数据量同时保持性能。文章介绍了清洗、标注和筛选视频数据的策略，强调在质量与规模之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Behaviorally fingerprinting Ox Alpha's provenance
items.title_zh: 基于行为指纹识别 Ox Alpha 的来源
items.summary_en: A study on behaviorally fingerprinting to verify the provenance of Ox Alpha, discussing how interaction patterns and behavioral signals can help determine origin and detect tampering, while noting limitations and potential misuse.
items.summary_zh: 研究通过行为指纹识别来验证 Ox Alpha 的来源，讨论互动模式与行为信号如何帮助确认起源并检测篡改，同时指出方法的局限性与潜在滥用风险。

items.title_en: Aspirational Clownmaxxing and Joey's cadillac todo list
items.title_zh: 雄心勃勃的自我设定与 Joey 的 Cadillac 待办清单
items.summary_en: A playful essay on balancing big ambitions with practical steps, using the metaphor of an over-the-top to-do list. It nudges engineers to set meaningful, achievable goals while keeping a sense of humor.
items.summary_zh: 以夸张的待办清单为隐喻，聊如何在雄心与现实之间取得平衡。作者鼓励工程师设定有意义且可执行的目标，同时保持幽默感。

items.title_en: How HN: Qisutu – an open-source, self-hosted ticketing and service desk
items.title_zh: HN：Qisutu——开源自托管的工单与服务台
items.summary_en: Qisutu is an open-source, self-hosted ticketing and service desk solution, outlining its architecture, deployment considerations, and use cases for teams seeking privacy-preserving support tooling.
items.summary_zh: Qisutu 是一个开源的自托管工单和服务台解决方案，介绍了其架构、部署考量以及适合需要隐私保护的团队使用场景。

items.title_en: Vim's UserGettingBored Autocmd
items.title_zh: Vim 的 UserGettingBored 自动命令
items.summary_en: Explains an approach to creating a custom autocommand named UserGettingBored to automate routine tasks in Vim, with example code for practical productivity.
items.summary_zh: Vim 的 UserGettingBored 自动命令提供一个实用又有趣的 Vim 小技巧：自定义自动命令组，用于自动化重复编辑，提升日常工作效率。文中给出实现与定制的示例代码。

items.title_en: Needle: The benchmark your search engine can't memorize
items.title_zh: Needle：你的搜索引擎无法记忆的基准
items.summary_en: Needle proposes a benchmark that tests a search engine's ability to remember and reason over past queries, highlighting memory constraints.
items.summary_zh: Needle 提出一个基准，评估搜索引擎记忆并推理历史查询的能力，突出其记忆方面的局限。

items.title_en: One Go binary, one YAML file, one SQLite database: I wrote my monitoring tool
items.title_zh: Show HN：我写了一个监控工具，只有一个 Go 二进制、一个 YAML 文件和一个 SQLite 数据库
items.summary_en: A minimalist monitoring tool built as a single Go binary with a YAML config and a SQLite backend demonstrates how lean tooling can still deliver practical observability. The write-up covers design decisions, usability, and deployment simplicity.
items.summary_zh: 作者用单一的 Go 二进制、YAML 配置和 SQLite 数据库打造了一个极简监控工具，展示了精简工具在可观测性上的可行性。文章讲解了设计选择、易用性及部署的简化。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built self-hosted deployment automation tool for Windows and IIS
items.title_zh: Show HN: 我构建了面向 Windows 与 IIS 的自托管部署自动化工具
items.summary_en: FDeploy provides a self hosted deployment automation tool designed for Windows environments and IIS, enabling teams to manage deployments without relying on cloud services. It focuses on control, security, and config driven pipelines compatible with Windows ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: FDeploy 提供面向 Windows 与 IIS 的自托管部署自动化工具，便于团队在内部基础设施上运行部署管线。它强调对控制权、安全性和基于配置的工作流的支持，适配 Windows 生态系统。

items.title_en: The world may have less time than it thinks on climate change
items.title_zh: 全球在应对气候变化的时间可能比想象中更短
items.summary_en: A commentary argues that remaining time to avert dangerous climate impacts is shrinking due to faster-than-expected warming and tipping point risks. The piece implies urgency for rapid decarbonization, policy action, and resilient infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为由于温升高于预期以及潜在拐点的风险，全球用于应对气候变化的时间正在缩短。呼吁加速减碳、加强政策与基础设施韧性，以避免严重后果。

items.title_en: OpenAI's Head of Data Centers Has Left the Company
items.title_zh: OpenAI 数据中心负责人离职
items.summary_en: OpenAI confirms the departure of its head of data centers, signaling leadership changes in the company’s infrastructure strategy. The move could influence hardware choices, energy efficiency initiatives, and scaling plans for AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 确认数据中心负责人离职，表明公司在基础设施战略上的领导层变动。这一举措可能影响硬件选择、能源效率计划及 AI 工作负载的扩展策略。

items.title_en: Thoughts on Pope Leo XIV's Magnifica Humanitas
items.title_zh: 关于莱奥十四世的‘宏伟仁爱’观念的思考
items.summary_en: A reflective meditation on humane leadership and public morality in the digital era, using Pope Leo XIV’s Magnifica Humanitas as a lens. It argues that tech leaders should balance ambition with empathy, transparency, and service to users.
items.summary_zh: 本文以莱奥十四世的‘Magnifica Humanitas’为镜头，思考数字时代的仁爱领导与公共道德。它主张科技领袖在野心与同理心、透明度和以用户为本之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Mark Zuckerberg's Social Reckoning
items.title_zh: 马克·扎克伯格的社会自省
items.summary_en: A critical profile of Mark Zuckerberg's impact on social media, tracing how Facebook's design and business incentives shaped discourse, moderation, and trust. The piece argues that platform architecture creates systemic challenges for democracy and user welfare, prompting calls for reform.
items.summary_zh: 本文深入剖析马克·扎克伯格及其社媒帝国对公共话语的深远影响，追踪 Facebook 的设计与商业激励如何塑造舆论、内容治理与用户信任。文章指出平台架构带来民主与用户福祉的系统性挑战，促使人们呼吁改革。

items.title_en: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers
items.title_zh: 柏林正遭黑客勒索
items.summary_en: Berlin has faced ransomware pressure targeting municipal services, raising concerns about city resilience and critical infrastructure security.
items.summary_zh: 柏林的市政服务遭遇勒索攻击，凸显城市韧性与关键基础设施安全的挑战。强调为城市系统建立强健的网络防护与应急响应能力的重要性。

items.title_en: Show HN: We built the smallest dual-band aircraft tracker
items.title_zh: Show HN：我们做了最小的双频飞行器跟踪器
items.summary_en: A Show HN project building a tiny dual-band ADS-B receiver for aircraft tracking; demonstrates accessible hardware and open-source tooling for aviation enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了一个超小型双频 ADS-B 航机跟踪器的实现，体现了面向爱好者的开源硬件与工具链。

items.title_en: CMS with AI, Not AI CMS: Wagtail 8.0's New API
items.title_zh: Wagtail 8.0 的新 API：AI 驱动的 CMS 还是 AI CMS？
items.summary_en: Wagtail 8.0 introduces a new API to expose programmatic access for AI-assisted workflows, emphasizing an AI-enabled CMS rather than an AI-only system.
items.summary_zh: Wagtail 8.0 推出新的 API，旨在为 AI 辅助工作流提供编程化访问，强调 AI 驅动的内容管理系统而非仅靠 AI 的系统。

items.title_en: Running SQLite Apps on Docker and Kubernetes with Litestream
items.title_zh: 在 Docker 与 Kubernetes 上使用 Litestream 运行 SQLite 应用
items.summary_en: Litestream enables durable, cloud-native SQLite deployments by streaming writes to object storage, letting SQLite apps run safely in Docker and Kubernetes without a separate server. The post walks through setup tradeoffs, performance considerations, and scenarios where this approach shines.
items.summary_zh: Litestream 通过把写入数据流式传送到对象存储，使 SQLite 应用能够在 Docker 和 Kubernetes 上实现持久化与云原生特性。文中讨论了部署要点、性能取舍，以及此方案适用的用例。

items.title_en: Interactive pattern discovery in binaries (FF-16-TUI)
items.title_zh: 在二进制中进行交互式模式发现（FF-16-TUI）
items.summary_en: FF-16-TUI is a terminal UI tool for interactive pattern discovery in binaries, enabling researchers to explore binary code patterns more efficiently.
items.summary_zh: FF-16-TUI 是一个用于在终端中交互式发现二进制代码模式的工具，帮助研究者更高效地探索代码模式。

items.title_en: Apple Maps Ads Are Here, and There's No Way to Turn Them Off
items.title_zh: Apple Maps 广告上线，无法关闭
items.summary_en: Apple Maps now features ads, with no opt-out option, signaling a new revenue channel for the platform. The move raises questions about user experience, ad targeting within maps, and privacy implications as location data potentially informs advertising. It highlights a broader trend of services monetizing core apps.
items.summary_zh: Apple Maps 引入广告且无法关闭，标志着该平台新的收入渠道。此举引发对用户体验、地图内广告定位以及隐私影响的担忧，因为位置信息可能用于广告。反映出越来越多的服务将核心应用商业化的趋势。

items.title_en: Show HN: A lightweight, stateless database for agent memory
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向代理记忆的轻量无状态数据库
items.summary_en: A compact, stateless database designed to store memory for AI agents, enabling scalable, persistent context without server-side state.
items.summary_zh: 一个紧凑且无状态的数据库，专为 AI 代理的记忆存储而设计，支持在无服务端状态的情况下实现可扩展的上下文持久化。

items.title_en: MySQL CDC to BigQuery: what periodic syncs miss, and how binlog avoids it
items.title_zh: MySQL CDC 到 BigQuery：周期性同步漏掉的是什么，以及二进制日志如何避免
items.summary_en: Periodic CDC syncing can miss changes between MySQL and BigQuery, leading to data lag. A binlog-based approach captures changes more promptly, reducing latency and improving consistency.
items.summary_zh: 周期性 CDC 同步可能错过 MySQL 与 BigQuery 之间的变更，导致数据存在延迟。基于二进制日志的方式能更及时地捕获变更，降低延迟并提升一致性，文章还讨论了模式演化、分批处理以及故障恢复等实务要点。

items.title_en: 'They shot all their weapons; they trashed their ships; they ran out of money'
items.title_zh: 他们把所有武器都用光、船只被毁、钱也花光了
items.summary_en: The Guardian piece argues that Google complied with Trump's 'Lake America' map rename order, illustrating a broader pattern of tech industry capitulation to political pressure. It analyses implications for policy, platform governance, and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出 Google 遵循特朗普的‘Lake America’ 地图改名指令，折射科技行业对政治压力的趋附趋势及其对治理和用户体验的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Debian: Retiring from the Project (Vv221)
items.title_zh: Debian：从项目中退休
items.summary_en: Debian developer announces retirement from the Debian project, reflecting on community governance, sustainability, and how long-term stewardship shaped the distro.
items.summary_zh: Debian 社区宣布某成员从项目退休，回顾了社区治理、可持续性以及长期维护对发行版的重要影响。

items.title_en: My open source project's donations no longer go through my bank account
items.title_zh: 我的开源项目捐款不再经银行账户处理
items.summary_en: Donations to my open-source project now flow through Open Collective, simplifying fundraising and improving transparency. The post explains why the change was made and how backers can contribute.
items.summary_zh: 我的开源项目捐款现改通过 Open Collective 处理，简化筹资流程并提升透明度。文中解释了改动原因以及支持者如何捐款。

items.title_en: A better SQL in 11 lines of code
items.title_zh: 11 行代码写出更好的 SQL
items.summary_en: Shows a tiny, readable approach to SQL, harnessing a minimal DSL or clever composition to express complex queries in 11 lines. This demonstrates how small tooling can dramatically simplify data querying and improve readability and correctness.
items.summary_zh: 用 11 行代码就实现更好的 SQL：通过一个极简 DSL 或巧妙的组合，给出更清晰、可维护的查询写法。此示例展示了极小型语言工具也能显著简化数据查询并提升可读性与正确性。

items.title_en: The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
items.title_zh: 2026 年 AI 的现状：走向 ROI
items.summary_en: McKinsey assesses AI adoption across industries, emphasizing ROI-driven maturity as essential for broader deployment. The report highlights governance, data readiness, and talent as key levers, while warning against hype without concrete use cases and measurable outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 麦肯锡评估了各行业 AI 的落地现状，强调以 ROI 为导向的成熟度对更广泛部署至关重要。报告指出治理、数据就绪度与人才是关键杠杆，同时警示在缺乏实际用例与可衡量结果时不能盲目乐观。

items.title_en: Secrets of the Atomic City
items.title_zh: 原子城的秘密
items.summary_en: Longreads investigates the legacy of radiation exposure and nuclear industry in a forgotten American town, tracing how secrets, safety, and policy shaped residents' lives. It weaves personal stories with industry histories to reveal systemic risk and resilience.
items.summary_zh: 长篇报道追溯一个被遗忘的美国小镇在辐射暴露与核工业遗产中的历史，揭示秘密、安全与政策如何影响居民生活。通过讲述个人故事与行业史，呈现出系统性风险与韧性。

items.title_en: GitHub Publishes IPv6 Addresses for Git SSH remotes
items.title_zh: GitHub 为 Git 的 SSH 远程连接公开 IPv6 地址
items.summary_en: GitHub published IPv6 addresses for Git over SSH remotes, easing native IPv6 connectivity for developers; still dual-stack networks, potential security considerations.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 为 Git 的 SSH 远程连接公开了 IPv6 地址，提升原生 IPv6 的连通性，同时在双栈网络环境下仍需关注安全与配置。

items.title_en: Infrastructure as Raclette
items.title_zh: 把基础设施当成拉克莱特火锅
items.summary_en: A playful take on infrastructure design proposing a 'raclette' metaphor—sharing, melting, and layering infrastructure to reduce toil, with arguments for simpler, more humane tooling.
items.summary_zh: 以拉克莱特火锅为隐喻，讨论把基础设施设计成更易分享、分层且更人性化的工具，旨在降低运维负担。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Technical Report [pdf]
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 技术报告
items.summary_en: A technical report detailing Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture, training improvements, and performance benchmarks. It showcases progress in high-performance language models and deployment considerations.
items.summary_zh: 技术报告介绍了 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的架构、训练改进与性能基准，展示了高性能语言模型的进展及部署要点。

items.title_en: Dissecting the Apple M1 GPU, the End
items.title_zh: 拆解 Apple M1 GPU：终章
items.summary_en: Wrapping up a multi-part examination of the Apple M1 GPU, the article highlights architectural quirks, performance limits, and how they affect driver development and Linux on Apple Silicon. It signals the transition toward newer Apple Silicon while older M1-era issues linger in compatibility work.
items.summary_zh: 对 Apple M1 GPU 的多篇拆解收尾，强调其架构特性、性能边界，以及这些发现对驱动开发和在 Apple Silicon 上的 Linux 兼容性的影响。预示着向更新的 Apple Silicon 过渡，同时仍需解决与 M1 时代相关的兼容性挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: Academa – Long-form STEM lecture videos generated by LLMs
items.title_zh: Show HN：Academa——由大语言模型生成的长篇 STEM 讲座视频
items.summary_en: Academa uses LLMs to generate long-form STEM lecture videos, offering scalable, on-demand access to advanced content. The approach raises questions about quality control, sourcing, and the role of AI in education.
items.summary_zh: Academa 使用大型语言模型生成长篇 STEM 讲座视频，为高阶内容提供可扩展、按需的学习资源。这种做法也带来质量控制、信息来源与教育中人工智能角色等讨论。

items.title_en: Spark: Sparklines in your shell
items.title_zh: Spark：在命令行中显示 Sparklines 的工具
items.summary_en: Spark brings inline sparklines to the shell, turning numeric streams into compact visual summaries without leaving the terminal. It makes quick trend spotting possible in scripts and day-to-day command work.
items.summary_zh: Spark 将内联火花图带入命令行，使数字流在不离开终端的情况下被压缩成可视摘要。它让在脚本和日常命令工作中快速感知趋势成为可能。

items.title_en: Google's Obedience to Trump's "Lake America" Order Follows a Depressing Pattern
items.title_zh: 谷歌对特朗普‘Lake America’命令的服从反映出令人沮丧的模式
items.summary_en: Google policies on renaming maps to reflect Trump's 'Lake America' directive illustrate a pattern of tech platforms bending to political pressure, raising concerns about platform governance and user trust.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌对特朗普“Lake America”指令的遵从，折射科技平台屈从政治压力的趋势，引发对治理与用户信任的担忧。

items.title_en: Data centers' 'oh s–t' moment
items.title_zh: 数据中心的‘ oh s–t ’ 时刻
items.summary_en: Politico reports on a critical moment for data centers amid energy, climate, and supply chain pressures, potentially forcing rapid modernization and relocation.
items.summary_zh: 《政客》报道数据中心在能源、气候与供应链压力下的关键时刻，或催促迅速的现代化与迁移。分析停电、用能约束与政策变动如何重塑基础设施格局。

items.title_en: Anthropic tells staff to work from home due to possible security team strike
items.title_zh: Anthropic 因安全团队可能罢工而通知员工居家办公
items.summary_en: Anthropic directs staff to work from home amid a possible security team strike, which could slow incident response and infrastructure maintenance. The move highlights how staffing dynamics can impact security operations and day-to-day product development under pressure.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 因安全团队可能罢工而指示员工居家办公，可能减缓应急响应与基础设施维护。这一举措反映出人员变动在高压情况下对安全运营与日常产品开发的影响。

items.title_en: Milo Yiannopoulos Detained by ICE in Louisiana
items.title_zh: Milo Yiannopoulos 在路易斯安那州被 ICE 扣留
items.summary_en: The incident reports Milo Yiannopoulos being detained by ICE in Louisiana, illustrating how high-profile individuals encounter immigration enforcement. It touches on procedural context and public attention.
items.summary_zh: 报道称 Milo Yiannopoulos 在路易斯安那州被移民执法机构扣留，体现知名人物与边境执法交集。文章概述事件经过及其可能的法律与程序背景。

items.title_en: "Famous Deep Learning Papers", David Bau
items.title_zh: David Bau 的《著名深度学习论文》
items.summary_en: David Bau curates a compendium of influential deep learning papers, with commentary on their insights and lasting impact on the field. The collection serves as a useful reference for researchers and practitioners.
items.summary_zh: David Bau 汇编了若干具有影响力的深度学习论文，并对其洞见及长期影响进行评述，成为研究者和从业者的有用参考。

items.title_en: Ripping Off the Hey.com Band-Aid
items.title_zh: 照搬 Hey.com 的 Band-Aid 设计
items.summary_en: An analysis of Hey.com's onboarding and UX approach, considering how similar patterns might be adopted elsewhere. The piece weighs trade-offs around privacy, user friction, and trust, offering practical lessons for consumer apps.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Hey.com 的入门与用户体验设计，探讨在其他应用中采用相似模式的可行性。文章权衡隐私、用户摩擦与信任之间的权衡，给消费类应用带来可落地的设计教训。

items.title_en: Pop-2000, a lingua-franca POP-2 dialect
items.title_zh: Pop-2000：一种 POP-2 方言的通用语言
items.summary_en: Introduces Pop-2000, a lingua franca dialect of POP-2 designed to facilitate communication across language ecosystems. The post delves into design goals and potential use cases for retro-inspired language tooling.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Pop-2000，一种以 POP-2 为基础的通用方言，旨在促进不同语言生态的互操作。探讨设计目标及在复古风格语言工具中的潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: LibreOffice 26.8 Released with Many Nice Improvements
items.title_zh: LibreOffice 26.8 发布，改进颇多
items.summary_en: LibreOffice 26.8 arrives with a suite of improvements, including performance tweaks, better compatibility with document formats, and user-facing polish. The release underscores the ongoing vitality of open-source office software and its role as a robust alternative to proprietary suites. Expect smoother workflows and compatibility gains for complex documents.
items.summary_zh: LibreOffice 26.8 正式发布，带来性能优化、文件格式兼容性提升及界面细节改进等多项改动。此次更新凸显开源办公软件的活力及其对比商用套件的可观竞争力，预计将提升处理复杂文档的流畅度与兼容性。

items.title_en: BSDnas – fork that continues TrueNAS CORE on current FreeBSD
items.title_zh: BSDnas：在当前 FreeBSD 上继续 TrueNAS CORE 的分叉
items.summary_en: BSDnas forks TrueNAS CORE onto current FreeBSD to keep the legacy storage platform alive for users who depend on it. The fork preserves familiar ZFS-based features and community support as the original project pivots away from CORE, illustrating how forks sustain long lived OSS stacks.
items.summary_zh: BSDnas 将 TrueNAS CORE 分叉到当前的 FreeBSD 上，以维持对旧版存储平台的依赖。此分叉在原项目转向新方向时，保留了熟悉的 ZFS 功能与社区支持，体现了分叉在长期开源栈中的作用。

items.title_en: Commercially Available Bike Generators Are Not Sustainable
items.title_zh: 市售自行车发电机并非可持续
items.summary_en: A critical teardown of commercially available bike generators, arguing they are not a sustainable energy solution due to user effort, limited output, and lifecycle costs. The piece encourages focusing on real-world energy systems and efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 对市售自行车发电机进行批判性评估，认为作为能源解决方案并不可持续，因为需要大量用户体力投入、产出有限及寿命成本高。文章倡导把注意力放在现实可行的能源系统与效率提升上。

items.title_en: My life was changed by four sentences in four books
items.title_zh: 四本书中的四句话改变了我的生活
items.summary_en: A reflective piece credits four sentences from four books as pivotal moments, showing how a few words can crystallize big ideas. It offers a concise meditation on the power of literature to shape thinking.
items.summary_zh: 一篇反思文章将四本书中的四句话视为关键时刻，展示几句话如何凝练出重大思想。文章对文学改变思考方式的力量做了简明的沉思。

items.title_en: Zod v4.5 adds schema compilation (3-9x faster validation)
items.title_zh: Zod v4.5 增加模式编译（验证速度提升 3-9 倍）
items.summary_en: Zod v4.5 introduces schema compilation, delivering 3–9x faster validation by pre-compiling schemas for runtime use. This change eases performance bottlenecks in TypeScript apps relying on runtime validation.
items.summary_zh: Zod v4.5 引入模式编译，通过事先将模式编译为可直接执行的代码，在运行时实现 3–9 倍的验证加速，缓解 TypeScript 应用的验证性能瓶颈。

items.title_en: Man Charged with 3 Felonies for Breaking 3D-Printed 'Decoy' Flock Camera
items.title_zh: 男子因破坏3D打印的诱饵 flock 摄像头被起诉
items.summary_en: A man is charged with three felonies after breaking a 3D-printed decoy flock camera, illustrating legal risk around DIY surveillance gear.
items.summary_zh: 一名男子因破坏一台3D打印的诱饵牧群摄像头而被控三项重罪，凸显 DIY 监控设备的法律风险。

items.title_en: DOJ prosecutes single FOIA dodger while defending systemwide evasion
items.title_zh: DOJ 起诉单一 FOIA 逃避者，同时为系统性规避辩护
items.summary_en: The DOJ prosecutes a single FOIA requester while defending broad systemwide exemptions, highlighting tensions between transparency and government secrecy.
items.summary_zh: 司法部起诉单一FOIA请求者，同时为广泛的系统性豁免辩护，凸显透明度与政府保密之间的张力。

items.title_en: A few feral cats in an ALGOL trenchcoat.
items.title_zh: ALGOL 风衣中的几只野猫
items.summary_en: A whimsical piece weaving metaphor about old ALGOL language with modern programming culture; highlights nostalgia and language design debates.
items.summary_zh: 以 ALGOL 这门古老语言为素材，穿上现代编程文化的外衣，描绘怀旧与语言设计讨论的趣味场景。

items.title_en: Graze Joins Flipboard
items.title_zh: Graze 加入 Flipboard
items.summary_en: Graze joins Flipboard, likely integrating its content curation into Flipboard's magazine-style experience. The move signals consolidation in content discovery and distribution.
items.summary_zh: Graze 加入 Flipboard，预计将把其内容策展融入 Flipboard 的杂志式体验。此举反映了内容发现与分发领域的整合趋势。

items.title_en: Being kicked out of the tech industry
items.title_zh: 被赶出科技行业
items.summary_en: A personal essay about barriers, discrimination, or burnout that lead someone to leave tech, highlighting the human cost of tech culture. It underscores the need for inclusive environments and supportive careers.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇个人随笔，讲述离开科技行业背后的挫折、排斥与倦怠，以及科技文化对个人的代价。呼吁建立更具包容性的工作环境和更具支持性的职业路径。

items.title_en: The teenage girls behind a $25 minimum wage fight in rural Alaska
items.title_zh: 农村阿拉斯加推动最低工资至 25 美元的年轻女性们
items.summary_en: Profiles teenage girls organizing a ballot effort to raise the minimum wage to $25 in rural Alaska, highlighting youth political engagement and local economic concerns. The story shows how grassroots activism interacts with policy and media coverage.
items.summary_zh: 报道在偏远阿拉斯加地区推动最低工资到 25 美元的青少年女性组织者，突出青年参与政治与地方经济议题。展示草根行动如何影响政策制定与媒体关注。

items.title_en: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization
items.title_zh: AutoSaddler：自动化 Harness 优化
items.summary_en: Introduces AutoSaddler, a method to automatically optimize a computing or ML harness configuration to improve performance and reproducibility. It describes algorithmic strategies for tuning inputs, pipelines, and measurement hooks.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 AutoSaddler，一种自动优化计算/ML 测试系统（harness）配置以提升性能与可重复性的技术。文中给出调优输入、流水线与度量钩子的算法策略。

items.title_en: 12TB Steam leak reveals unseen Half-Life 2: Episode 3 builds
items.title_zh: 12TB 泄漏揭示未公开的 Half-Life 2: Episode 3 构建
items.summary_en: A massive 12TB leak surfaces unseen HL2: Episode 3 builds and assets, offering a window into Valve's abandoned project and the evolution of game development pipelines. It raises IP and archival questions.
items.summary_zh: 一份12TB 的泄漏曝光了尚未公开的《半条命2：Episode 3》构建与资源，揭示了开发流程的早期阶段与放弃项目的历史，同时引发知识产权与档案保存的讨论。

items.title_en: e is a customizable self-aware Emacs-like editor written in Chez Scheme
items.title_zh: e：用 Chez Scheme 编写、可定制且具自我意识的 Emacs 风格编辑器
items.summary_en: e is a customizable, self-aware Emacs-like editor written in Chez Scheme. The design leans on Scheme's metaprogramming and introspection to let users reshape the editor at runtime, potentially blurring lines between editor and environment. It serves as a playful showcase of how a Lisp-based tool can be deeply adapted to individual workflows.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个用 Chez Scheme 编写、可高度定制、具自我意识特性的 Emacs 风格编辑器。依托 Scheme 的元编程与自省能力，用户可以在运行时深度改造编辑器的行为与工作流，展示了 Lisp 语言在编辑器领域的深度定制潜力。

items.title_en: The service XCancel is stopped until further notice
items.title_zh: XCancel 服务暂停，待另行通知
items.summary_en: XCancel is halted until further notice, with status updates expected as engineers assess current issues. Users should monitor for a rollback plan and potential alternatives in the meantime.
items.summary_zh: XCancel 服务暂停，待后续通知。技术团队正在评估当前问题，用户需关注后续的恢复计划与可能的替代方案。

items.title_en: Run Minecraft in a Windows sandbox for computer use agents
items.title_zh: 在 Windows 沙箱中运行 Minecraft 以用于计算代理
items.summary_en: A guide shows how to run Minecraft inside a Windows sandbox to support AI agents or automated tasks in isolated environments.
items.summary_zh: 指南展示如何在 Windows 沙箱中运行 Minecraft，以便在隔离环境中支持 AI 代理或自动化任务。

items.title_en: The Server Called Paranoia: Defend Autistici/Inventati Before Sept25 Sabot Media
items.title_zh: 名为 Paranoia 的服务器：在九月二十五日前为 Autistici/Inventati 进行防御
items.summary_en: The piece calls for a coordinated defense of a critical hosting node used by anti-surveillance and privacy-focused community Autistici/Inventati, ahead of a looming date that could see media disruptions. It underscores the fragility of activist infrastructure and the need for community resilience and rapid response.
items.summary_zh: 文章呼吁在9月25日前共同保护为 Autistici/ Inventati 提供服务的关键服务器 Paranoia，防止媒体对该节点的破坏。此事凸显隐私与反审查基础设施的脆弱性，以及社区协作与快速响应的重要性。

items.title_en: Superhuman Attention
items.title_zh: 超级人类注意力
items.summary_en: PerfLoop analyzes how attention mechanisms and infrastructure can be optimized for maximum throughput, discussing bottlenecks and how to design systems that capture users' focus. The piece ties attention economics to performance engineering in software.
items.summary_zh: PerfLoop 文章探讨如何将注意力机制与系统设计结合，优化以实现最大吞吐与用户关注度。讨论瓶颈以及在软件中应用注意力经济学与性能工程的关系。

items.title_en: The Loss of Changelogs
items.title_zh: 变更日志的流失
items.summary_en: Argues that modern software release cycles have weakened changelogs, making it harder for developers and users to track updates and assess risk. Proposes practices to maintain clear release notes and changelog discipline.
items.summary_zh: 指出当下的软件发布节奏使变更日志逐渐缺失，开发者与用户难以追踪更新内容与评估风险。提出维持清晰发布说明与变更日志规范的做法。

items.title_en: Kmart Digicam Mod Part 2
items.title_zh: Kmart Digicam Mod 第2部分
items.summary_en: Continues a retro hardware hacking project, detailing further modifications to a cheap Kmart digicam, power considerations, and lessons learned for hobbyists.
items.summary_zh: Kmart Digicam Mod 第2部分延续这项复古硬件改造计划，介绍对低价 Kmart 数码相机的进一步改装、供电要点以及给爱好者的经验教训。

items.title_en: I think the data center backlash is mostly about data centers
items.title_zh: 我认为对数据中心的反对，主要针对数据中心本身
items.summary_en: The piece argues that backlash against data centers is largely about the facilities themselves—noise, energy use, heat, and local impact—rather than the broader concept of digital infrastructure. It suggests practical reforms like improved efficiency, on-site renewables, and better siting to address concerns.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为对数据中心的反对主要来自设施本身的影响，如噪声、能耗、热排放和对周边的影响，而非数字基础设施的概念。文中建议通过提升效率、就地可再生能源与更合适的选址等实际改进来应对担忧。

items.title_en: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
items.title_zh: Cursor 在 SpaceX 收购后的未来走向
items.summary_en: Our decision clarifies Cursor's fate and how it will be supported after the SpaceX acquisition. It outlines ongoing commitments to users and developers, and hints at how Cursor may fit into SpaceX's broader product ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 关于 Cursor 在 SpaceX 收购后的未来走向，我们给出明确的支持与发展路线。文中强调对用户与开发者的承诺，以及 Cursor 在 SpaceX 生态中的潜在定位。

items.title_en: A Great Rebalancing Is Coming
items.title_zh: 即将到来的重大再平衡
items.summary_en: Global power dynamics are shifting toward Asia as demographics and growth patterns diverge from Western centers. The article urges policymakers and tech companies to adapt with diversified supply chains, new alliances, and investments in capabilities to ride the coming rebalancing.
items.summary_zh: 全球力量格局正向亚洲倾斜，人口与增长模式的分化正在改变西方中心的现状。文章敦促政策制定者与科技企业通过多元化供应链、新型联盟以及能力投资来应对逐步到来的再平衡。

items.title_en: Zig to remove support for wasi-libc
items.title_zh: Zig 将移除对 wasi-libc 的支持
items.summary_en: Zig language project plans to drop wasi-libc compatibility, affecting WebAssembly cross-platform projects. The move may simplify the toolchain but requires developers to adapt to alternative WASI setups.
items.summary_zh: Zig 语言计划移除对 wasi-libc 的兼容性，影响基于 WebAssembly 的跨平台项目。此举或简化工具链，但开发者需调整到替代的 WASI 配置。

items.title_en: The turbulent AI era is here. The choices we make now are critical
items.title_zh: 动荡的 AI 时代已到来，我们现在的选择至关重要
items.summary_en: Further reflections on the turbulent AI era, emphasizing critical decisions around safety, governance, and responsible innovation. The message underscores the stakes of early actions.
items.summary_zh: 对动荡的 AI 时代再度进行反思，强调在安全、治理和负责任创新方面的关键抉择。强调早期行动的影响与风险。

items.title_en: Category Theory for Kids
items.title_zh: 给孩子看的范畴理论
items.summary_en: Category Theory for Kids introduces core ideas—objects, arrows (morphisms), and composition—in an accessible way for younger readers. It offers a gentle doorway into abstract math and helps bridge to logic and theoretical computer science.
items.summary_zh: 这篇面向儿童的范畴理论入门以易懂的方式介绍对象、态射和组合等核心概念，帮助年轻读者理解抽象数学。它为进入逻辑与理论计算机科学搭起了温和的桥梁。

items.title_en: Treasury bonds are becoming less special
items.title_zh: 美国国债的“特殊性”正在减弱
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Treasury bonds are losing their traditional status as a unique, ultra-safe benchmark as market dynamics evolve, with implications for asset allocation, yields, and the perceived safety of government debt.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为美债作为独特、极其安全的基准地位正在被市场演变所削弱，这将影响资产配置、收益率以及政府债务的安全性认知。

items.title_en: Trial is 40 days. Not until you're 40
items.title_zh: 试用期是40天。直到你40岁才有
items.summary_en: A lighthearted note jokes about a 40-day trial period, playing on the phrase not until you're 40.
items.summary_zh: 一则轻松的玩笑，围绕40天的试用期展开，玩笑地暗指“不是等到你40岁”。

items.title_en: Hot Chips 2026: Intel's Diamond Rapids
items.title_zh: Hot Chips 2026：英特尔的 Diamond Rapids
items.summary_en: Hot Chips 2026 will feature Intel’s Diamond Rapids, a server-class CPU family aimed at data centers with stronger AI acceleration and memory bandwidth. The presentation signals architectural refinements and competitive positioning against AMD and ARM-based servers.
items.summary_zh: Hot Chips 2026 将聚焦英特尔的 Diamond Rapids——面向数据中心、具备更强 AI 加速与内存带宽的服务器级处理器家族。相关介绍预示着在架构层面的优化以及与 AMD、基于 ARM 的服务器的竞争格局。

items.title_en: Forgotten History of Small Nuclear Reactors
items.title_zh: 小型核反应堆的被遗忘历史
items.summary_en: The piece revisits early experiments and proposals for small reactors, highlighting why they failed to become mainstream despite potential for modular power and grid resilience. It explains regulatory, economic, and safety hurdles that have long impeded SMR adoption, offering lessons for current SMR efforts.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾小型核反应堆的早期尝试与构想，解释尽管具有模块化潜力和提升电网韧性的前景，却未能成为主流。监管、经济与安全障碍长期制约着小型反应堆的普及，为当前的 SMR 发展提供了历史教训。

items.title_en: KHMS – a file-based long-term memory an LLM agent installs into itself
items.title_zh: KHMS：LLM 自身安装的基于文件的长期记忆
items.summary_en: Describes KHMS, a memory system that stores long-term memory for an LLM agent in files, enabling persistency beyond session scope. It discusses architecture, retrieval, and safety considerations.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 KHMS，这是一种把长期记忆以文件形式存储在 LLM 代理中的系统，使记忆在会话之外也可持久化。讨论其架构、检索机制与安全性等考量。

items.title_en: A Badass Way to Connect Programs Togther What Is OSC?
items.title_zh: A Badass Way To Connect Programs Togther What Is OSC?
items.summary_en: Explains OSC as a lightweight protocol to connect multimedia apps, enabling real-time control, routing, and synchronized workflows. The piece demonstrates practical setups and why OSC remains popular in creative coding and live performance.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 OSC（Open Sound Control）作为一种轻量级协议，用于连接多种多媒体应用，支持实时控制、路由与协同工作。文章给出实际应用场景与为何在创意编码与现场表演中仍然受欢迎的原因。

items.title_en: Twitter (Not affiliated with X Corp)
items.title_zh: Twitter（与 X Corp 无关）
items.summary_en: Maintenance page clarifies that this Twitter site is not affiliated with X Corp, signaling ongoing brand and governance complexities after the platform rebrand. The situation underscores the noise in domain-level branding in public web services.
items.summary_zh: 维护页明确该 Twitter 域名与 X Corp 无关，反映出平台更名后在品牌与治理上的混乱与复杂性。该情形凸显了公共网络服务中的域名 branding 问题。

items.title_en: The Performance Inequality Gap, 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年的性能不平等差距
items.summary_en: A provocative look at how performance gaps persist across hardware, software, and networks in 2026; calls for policy and toolchain changes to reduce inequality.
items.summary_zh: 对2026年的性能不平等现象进行深度分析，揭示硬件、软件和网络层面的差距，并呼吁通过工具链与政策改革缩小差距。

items.title_en: Meta agrees to settle social media addiction suit with states for up to $16B
items.title_zh: Meta 就社媒成瘾诉讼与各州和解，最高金额16亿美元
items.summary_en: Meta reaches a settlement with states over alleged social media addiction harms, with a potential payout of up to $16 billion. The agreement could drive design changes, transparency requirements, and funding for consumer-protection initiatives. It signals a broader push to curb addictive design patterns across platforms.
items.summary_zh: Meta 就社媒成瘾诉讼与各州达成和解，最高金额可达16亿美元。协议可能推动设计改动、透明度要求，并为消费者保护计划提供资金，体现了对平台上成瘾性设计模式的抑制趋向。

items.title_en: The Finn – an agent that lives in my router and complains about it
items.title_zh: The Finn：一个驻留在我的路由器里、对路由器发牢骚的智能体
items.summary_en: A lightweight edge AI project, The Finn runs on a home router to monitor network health and provide feedback. It playfully critiques the router while illustrating what tiny on-device agents can do for observability and user experience.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个在家用路由器上运行的边缘智能体原型，用于监控网络健康并提供反馈。它以幽默的方式对路由器进行吐槽，同时展示了小型在设备上运行的代理在可观测性和用户体验上的潜力。

items.title_en: Meta agrees multi-billion settlement to claims that its platforms harm children
items.title_zh: Meta 就儿童受社媒伤害问题达成多亿美元和解
items.summary_en: Meta settles with multiple states over alleged harms to minors on its platforms for a multi-billion-dollar amount. The accord is expected to include safeguards and ongoing oversight around youth safety features. The settlement underscores continuing regulatory pressure on platform designers to protect younger users.
items.summary_zh: Meta 就其平台对未成年人造成伤害的指控与多州达成数十亿美元级别的和解。协议预计将包含对青少年安全功能的保障措施与持续监督。这凸显了监管机构对平台在保护未成年用户方面继续施加压力。

items.title_en: Flyway for freeloaders, rollback implemented in Python
items.title_zh: 为白嫖党打造的 Flyway：用 Python 实现回滚
items.summary_en: A playful Python-based rollback implementation for a lightweight Flyway-like migration tool demonstrates how to add reversible migrations without heavy tooling. It highlights the importance of versioned migrations and how scripting languages can nimbly implement practical database change workflows.
items.summary_zh: 一个用 Python 实现回滚功能的轻量 Flyway 风格迁移工具演示，展示了如何在无需繁重工具的情况下实现可回滚的数据库迁移。强调版本化迁移的重要性，以及脚本语言在实现实用变更流程中的灵活性。

items.title_en: Police departments weren’t looking for Flock abuse. We did it for them.
items.title_zh: 警察部门本未主动调查 Flock 滥用，我们揭露了真实情况
items.summary_en: Investigative reporting reveals credible misuse of Flock cameras by law enforcement, uncovering how some departments relied on the system despite limited oversight. The piece raises accountability and privacy concerns about widespread surveillance tools.
items.summary_zh: 调查报道揭示部分警察部门对 Flock 摄像头的滥用情形，显示在缺乏有效监督下仍大量使用该系统。文章引发对大规模监控工具的问责与隐私担忧。

items.title_en: Claude permanently raising weekly limits by 25%
items.title_zh: Claude 将每周限制永久提升 25%
items.summary_en: Anthropic is permanently increasing Claude's weekly usage limits by 25%, enabling more API calls per week for developers and teams. The update improves throughput for chat-heavy workloads and experimentation, with modest cost implications.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 永久提升 Claude 的每周使用上限 25%，让开发者和团队每周可发起更多请求。此次调整提升了高负载对话型工作流的吞吐量，同时成本影响相对有限。

items.title_en: The elementary school pickup incident and the road ahead
items.title_zh: 小学接送事件及未来之路
items.summary_en: An elementary school pickup incident has sparked broader discussions about online discourse, real-world safety, and the road ahead for digital civility. The piece argues for calmer, more principled conversations, better moderation, and practical channels to address concerns without escalating tension.
items.summary_zh: 一起小学接送事件引发了关于在线言论、现实安全与数字公民素养的广泛讨论。文章倡导更冷静、守原则的对话，改进平台治理与建立更实用的反馈渠道，以避免事态升级。

items.title_en: The Wandering Yamamura Theater Troupe
items.title_zh: 漂泊的山村剧团
items.summary_en: The Wandering Yamamura Theater Troupe profiles a traveling performance group, exploring how itinerant theater negotiates space, audience, and tradition.
items.summary_zh: 本篇聚焦一支巡演剧团，探讨流动巡演如何在空间、观众与传统之间寻求平衡。文章突出移动剧场的韧性与不断演变的美学。
